rows.text_en: Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy ( Innovation Administration Division ), 044-203-5533, 5539

rows.source_ko: 제1장 총칙
rows.text_en: Chapter 1 General Provisions

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 산업통상부와 그 소속기관에 두는 보조기관ㆍ보좌기관의 직급 및 직급의 정원, 「정부조직법」 제2조제3항 및 제5항에 따라 실장ㆍ국장 밑에 두는 보조기관과 이에 상당하는 보좌기관의 설치 및 사무분장 등 「산업통상부와 그 소속기관 직제」에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this rule is to define matters delegated by the “Organization of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and Its Affiliated Agencies” and matters necessary for its implementation, such as the ranks and staffing levels of auxiliary and advisory agencies placed in the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and its affiliated agencies, the establishment of auxiliary agencies placed under directors and bureau chiefs pursuant to Article 2, Paragraphs 3 and 5of the “Government Organization Act” and advisory agencies equivalent thereto.

rows.source_ko: 제2장 산업통상부
rows.text_en: Chapter 2 Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy

rows.source_ko: 제2조(통상차관보) 통상차관보는 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Assistant Minister for Trade) The Assistant Minister for Trade shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(대변인) ① 대변인은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Spokesperson) ① The Spokesperson shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A.

rows.source_ko: ② 대변인 밑에 홍보담당관 및 디지털소통팀장 각 1명을 두되, 홍보담당관은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 공업연구관으로, 디지털소통팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ행정사무관 또는 공업연구관으로 보한다. <개정 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② One Public Relations Officer and one Digital Communication Team Leader shall be appointed under the Spokesperson; the Public Relations Officer shall be appointed as a Deputy Director-General, Secretary for Science and Technology, Secretary, or Industrial Research Officer, and the Digital Communication Team Leader shall be appointed as a Secretary for Science and Technology, Secretary, Industrial Officer, Administrative Officer, or Industrial Research Officer. <Amended Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ③ 홍보담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 대변인을 보좌한다. <개정 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Public Relations Officer assists the Spokesperson with respect to the following matters. <Amended Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 산업, 통상, 자원 등 주요 정책에 관한 홍보계획의 수립ㆍ조정 및 협의ㆍ지원
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment, coordination, consultation, and support of public relations plans regarding major policies such as industry, trade, and resources

rows.source_ko: 2. 내ㆍ외신 언론보도의 수집ㆍ분석 및 대응
rows.text_en: 2. Collection, Analysis, and Response to Domestic and Foreign Media Reports

rows.source_ko: 3. 대변인 업무 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning support for spokesperson duties

rows.source_ko: 4. 부(部) 내 업무의 대외 정책 발표사항 관리 및 브리핑 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the management of external policy announcements regarding internal Ministry affairs and support for briefings

rows.source_ko: 5. 인터뷰, 기고, 언론 출연 등 언론과 관련된 업무 및 행사의 지원ㆍ협조
rows.text_en: 5. Support and cooperation for media-related work and events, such as interviews, contributions, and media appearances

rows.source_ko: 6. 기자의 취재 및 언론사 관련 업무의 지원ㆍ협조
rows.text_en: 6. Support and cooperation for reporters' coverage and media-related affairs

rows.source_ko: 7. 전자브리핑 운영 및 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the operation and support of electronic briefings

rows.source_ko: 8. 산업통상부 소관 분야에 관한 해외홍보의 지원 및 외국어 홈페이지 운영 등에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning support for overseas promotion regarding fields under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and operation of foreign language websites, etc.

rows.source_ko: 9. 홍보전문성 제고를 위한 홍보교육에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning public relations training to enhance public relations expertise

rows.source_ko: 10. 정책홍보평가에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning policy promotion evaluation

rows.source_ko: 11. 산업통상부 소관 분야의 관련 기관ㆍ단체와의 홍보 협력 및 언론 관련 대외 기관과의 홍보 협의
rows.text_en: 11. Public relations cooperation with relevant agencies and organizations in fields under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy, and public relations consultation with external media agencies

rows.source_ko: 12. 그 밖에 홍보업무와 관련하여 부 내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 12. Other matters related to public relations that do not fall under the jurisdiction of other divisions within the Ministry

rows.source_ko: ④ 디지털소통팀장은 다음 사항에 관하여 대변인을 보좌한다. <개정 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Digital Communication Team assists the Spokesperson with respect to the following matters. <Amended Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 온라인 여론 동향의 수집ㆍ분석 및 대응
rows.text_en: 1. Collection, Analysis, and Response to Online Public Opinion Trends

rows.source_ko: 2. 인터넷 뉴스, 소셜미디어 등 온라인 홍보에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning online promotion, such as internet news and social media

rows.source_ko: 3. 산업통상부 소관 분야에 관한 홍보물 발간, 홍보 동영상 제작ㆍ홍보
rows.text_en: 3. Publication of promotional materials, production and promotion of promotional videos regarding fields under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy

rows.source_ko: 4. 그 밖에 디지털 소통과 관련한 업무 총괄
rows.text_en: 4. Overall management of other tasks related to digital communication

rows.source_ko: 제4조(감사관) ① 감사관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직 공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Auditor) ① The Auditor shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 감사관 밑에 감사담당관 1명을 두되, 감사담당관은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 공업연구관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: ② One audit officer shall be appointed under the auditor, and the audit officer shall be appointed from among deputy directors, science and technology secretaries, secretaries, or industrial research officers.

rows.source_ko: ③ 감사담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 감사관을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Audit Officer assists the Auditor in the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 산업통상부와 그 소속기관에 대한 감사
rows.text_en: 1. Audit of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and its affiliated agencies

rows.source_ko: 2. 산하기관(산하 공공기관 및 협회ㆍ단체를 포함한다. 이하 이 항에서 같다)에 대한 감사
rows.text_en: 2. Audit of affiliated organizations (including affiliated public institutions and associations/organizations; hereinafter the same applies in this paragraph)

rows.source_ko: 3. 다른 기관에 의한 산업통상부와 그 소속기관 및 산하기관에 대한 감사결과의 처리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the handling of audit results by other agencies regarding the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and its affiliated and subordinate agencies

rows.source_ko: 4. 진정 및 비위사항의 조사ㆍ처리
rows.text_en: 4. Investigation and Handling of Complaints and Misconduct

rows.source_ko: 5. 감사에 관한 통계의 유지 및 비위사항에 관한 요인의 분석
rows.text_en: 5. Maintenance of audit statistics and analysis of factors regarding misconduct

rows.source_ko: 6. 「부패방지 및 국민권익위원회의 설치와 운영에 관한 법률」 제8조에 따른 공직자 행동강령의 운영
rows.text_en: 6. Operation of the Code of Conduct for Public Officials pursuant to Article 8 of the Act on the Prevention of Corruption and the Establishment and Operation of the Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission

rows.source_ko: 7. 「공직자윤리법」에 따른 소속 공무원의 재산등록ㆍ심사
rows.text_en: 7. Registration and review of assets of affiliated public officials pursuant to the Public Officials Ethics Act

rows.source_ko: 8. 「공직자 등의 병역사항 신고 및 공개에 관한 법률」에 따른 소속 공무원의 병역신고
rows.text_en: 8. Military service report of affiliated public officials pursuant to the Act on the Reporting and Disclosure of Military Service Matters of Public Officials, etc.

rows.source_ko: 9. 그 밖에 장관이 감사에 관하여 지시한 사항의 처리
rows.text_en: 9. Handling of other matters instructed by the Minister regarding audits

rows.source_ko: 제5조(장관정책보좌관) 장관정책보좌관 중 1명은 고위공무원단에 속하는 별정직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. 다만, 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 대체하여 보하는 경우 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Ministerial Policy Advisor) One of the Ministerial Policy Advisors shall be appointed as a special-category public official belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B. However, if the position is replaced by a general-category public official belonging to the Senior Civil Service, the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: 제6조(기획조정실) ① 기획조정실장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Office of Planning and Coordination) ① The Head of the Office of Planning and Coordination shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A.

rows.source_ko: ② 「산업통상부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제9조제1항에 따라 기획조정실장 밑에 두는 보좌기관은 정책기획관 및 비상기획관으로 하며, 정책기획관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 하고, 비상안전기획관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 임기제공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: ② In accordance with Article 9, Paragraph 1 of the “Organization of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and its Affiliated Agencies,” the advisory bodies placed under the Director of Planning and Coordination shall be the Policy Planning Officer and the Emergency Planning Officer. The Policy Planning Officer shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B. The Emergency Safety Planning Officer shall be appointed as a fixed-term civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ③ 정책기획관은 「산업통상부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제9조제3항제1호부터 제24호까지의 사항에 관하여 기획조정실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Director of Policy Planning assists the Director of Planning and Coordination with respect to matters under subparagraphs 1 through 24 of Article 9, Paragraph 3 of the “Organization of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and its Affiliated Agencies.”

rows.source_ko: ④ 비상안전기획관은 「산업통상부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제9조제3항제25호부터 제31호까지의 사항에 관하여 기획조정실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Director of Emergency Safety Planning assists the Director of Planning and Coordination with respect to matters under subparagraphs 25 through 31 of Article 9, Paragraph 3 of the “Organization of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and its Affiliated Agencies.”

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 기획조정실장 밑에 기획재정담당관ㆍ혁신행정담당관ㆍ법무담당관ㆍ정보관리담당관ㆍ정보보호담당관 및 산업재난담당관을 두되, 기획재정담당관ㆍ혁신행정담당관ㆍ법무담당관ㆍ정보관리담당관ㆍ정보보호담당관 및 산업재난담당관은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 공업연구관으로 보한다. <개정 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ Under the Director of the Planning and Coordination Office, there shall be officers for Planning and Finance, Innovation Administration, Legal Affairs, Information Management, Information Security, and Industrial Disaster; provided that the officers for Planning and Finance, Innovation Administration, Legal Affairs, Information Management, Information Security, and Industrial Disaster shall be appointed as Deputy Directors, Senior Officers in Science and Technology, Senior Officers, or Research Officers in Industry. <Amended Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 기획재정담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Planning and Finance Officer assists the Director of the Planning and Coordination Office with respect to the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 산업ㆍ무역ㆍ통상ㆍ자원시책의 수립ㆍ종합ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Formulation, coordination, and management of industrial, trade, commerce, and resource policies

rows.source_ko: 2. 국정과제 및 대통령ㆍ국무총리 등의 지시사항에 대한 실천계획 수립ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment and management of implementation plans for national policy tasks and directives from the President, Prime Minister, etc.

rows.source_ko: 3. 중장기 재정운용계획의 수립
rows.text_en: 3. Establishment of Mid-to-Long-Term Fiscal Management Plan

rows.source_ko: 4. 예산 및 기금의 편성ㆍ조정 총괄
rows.text_en: 4. Overall management of budget and fund formulation and coordination

rows.source_ko: 5. 예산 및 기금의 집행ㆍ결산 총괄
rows.text_en: 5. Overall management of budget and fund execution and settlement

rows.source_ko: 6. 대규모 중장기 재정사업에 대한 사전 타당성 평가
rows.text_en: 6. Preliminary feasibility assessment for large-scale mid-to-long-term fiscal projects

rows.source_ko: 7. 예산 및 기금의 성과계획 수립
rows.text_en: 7. Establishment of performance plans for budgets and funds

rows.source_ko: 8. 재정사업의 사후 성과평가 및 사업 조정
rows.text_en: 8. Post-project performance evaluation and project adjustment of financial projects

rows.source_ko: 9. 국회 및 정당 등과의 정책 협조
rows.text_en: 9. Policy cooperation with the National Assembly and political parties, etc.

rows.source_ko: 10. 산업통상자원백서 발간
rows.text_en: 10. Publication of the Trade, Industry and Energy White Paper

rows.source_ko: 11. 그 밖에 실 내 다른 담당관의 소관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other officers within the office

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 혁신행정담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Innovation Administration Officer assists the Director of Planning and Coordination with respect to the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 업무처리절차의 개선, 조직문화의 혁신 등 부 내 행정관리업무의 총괄ㆍ지원
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management and support of administrative management tasks within the ministry, including improvement of work procedures and innovation of organizational culture

rows.source_ko: 2. 변화관리전략의 수립ㆍ집행
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment and Execution of Change Management Strategy

rows.source_ko: 3. 조직문화 개선을 위한 변화관리 등 교육계획의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 3. Establishment and implementation of training plans, including change management, for the improvement of organizational culture

rows.source_ko: 4. 변화관리 평가체계 구축 및 운영
rows.text_en: 4. Establishment and Operation of Change Management Evaluation System

rows.source_ko: 5. 조직진단 및 평가를 통한 조직과 정원의 관리
rows.text_en: 5. Management of Organization and Staffing through Organizational Diagnosis and Evaluation

rows.source_ko: 6. 정책자문위원회의 위원 구성 및 운영
rows.text_en: 6. Composition and Operation of the Policy Advisory Committee

rows.source_ko: 7. 산업통상부 소속 위원회의 운영 실태조사 및 지원ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 7. Operational Status Survey and Support/Management of Committees under the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy

rows.source_ko: 8. 소관 공공기관 및 산하단체의 등록 등 지원
rows.text_en: 8. Support for registration, etc. of relevant public institutions and affiliated organizations

rows.source_ko: 9. 소관 공공기관의 기관장 등 임원 인사에 관한 사항 지원
rows.text_en: 9. Support for matters concerning the personnel appointments of executives, including heads of relevant public institutions

rows.source_ko: 10. 소관 공공기관의 선진화계획 수립과 이행점검, 윤리경영 등 경영선진화 지원
rows.text_en: 10. Support for management advancement, including the establishment of advancement plans, implementation monitoring, and ethical management of relevant public institutions

rows.source_ko: 11. 소관 공공기관의 경영계획서 작성 및 그 이행 평가에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 11. Duties concerning the preparation of management plans for relevant public institutions and the evaluation of their implementation

rows.source_ko: 12. 연도별 성과관리시행계획의 수립 및 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 12. Establishment and overall coordination of annual performance management implementation plans

rows.source_ko: 13. 성과관리시스템의 구축ㆍ운영 및 성과관리를 위한 관련 지표의 개발
rows.text_en: 13. Establishment and operation of a performance management system and development of relevant indicators for performance management

rows.source_ko: 14. 직무성과계약제도의 운영
rows.text_en: 14. Operation of the Job Performance Contract System

Matters concerning disaster and safety management, such as the establishment and implementation of safety management plans in the relevant field and the designation and management of national infrastructure facilities, etc., carried out pursuant to the Framework Act on Disaster and Safety Management

rows.text_en: 11. Establishment and operation of a linkage system with agencies managing safety, disaster, and crisis situations

Article 7 Deleted <December 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제8조(운영지원과) 운영지원과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Operations Support Division) The Head of the Operations Support Division shall be appointed as a Deputy Director, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary.

rows.source_ko: 제9조(산업정책실) ① 산업정책실장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Industrial Policy Office) ① The Head of the Industrial Policy Office shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A.

rows.source_ko: ② 「산업통상부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제12조제1항에 따라 산업정책실장 밑에 두는 보좌기관은 산업정책관ㆍ지역경제정책관ㆍ제조산업정책관 및 중견기업정책관으로 하며, 산업정책관ㆍ지역경제정책관ㆍ제조산업정책관 및 중견기업정책관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: ② Pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 1 of the “Organization of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and its Affiliated Agencies,” the advisory bodies placed under the Director of Industrial Policy are the Director of Industrial Policy, the Director of Regional Economy Policy, the Director of Manufacturing Industry Policy, and the Director of Middle-sized Enterprise Policy; the Director of Industrial Policy, the Director of Regional Economy Policy, the Director of Manufacturing Industry Policy, and the Director of Middle-sized Enterprise Policy shall be appointed as general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ③ 산업정책관은 「산업통상부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제12조제3항제1호부터 제43호까지의 사항에 관하여 실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Director of Industrial Policy assists the Director with matters under subparagraphs 1 through 43 of Article 12, Paragraph 3 of the “Organization of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and its Affiliated Agencies.”

rows.source_ko: ④ 지역경제정책관은 「산업통상부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제12조제3항제44호부터 제60호까지의 사항에 관하여 실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Director of Regional Economic Policy assists the Director with matters under subparagraphs 44 through 60 of Article 12, Paragraph 3 of the “Organization of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and its Affiliated Agencies.”

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 제조산업정책관은 「산업통상부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제12조제3항제61호부터 제82호까지, 제99호 및 제100호의 사항에 관하여 실장을 보좌한다. <개정 2026. 6. 2., 2026. 10. 20.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Director General for Manufacturing Industry Policy assists the Director General with respect to matters under Article 12, Paragraph 3, Subparagraphs 61 through 82 , 99, and 100 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and Its Affiliated Agencies .” <Amended June 2, 2026; October 20, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 중견기업정책관은 「산업통상부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제12조제3항제86호부터 제98호까지의 사항에 관하여 실장을 보좌한다. <개정 2026. 6. 2.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Director General for Middle-Sized Enterprise Policy assists the Director General with respect to matters specified in Subparagraphs 86 through 98 of Article 12, Paragraph 3 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and Its Affiliated Agencies.” <Amended June 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 산업정책실에 산업정책과ㆍ산업일자리혁신과ㆍ산업환경과ㆍ지역경제총괄과ㆍ지역경제진흥과ㆍ입지총괄과ㆍ자동차과ㆍ조선해양플랜트과ㆍ엔지니어링디자인과ㆍ중견기업정책과ㆍ중견기업지원과ㆍ유통물류과ㆍ기업정책팀을 두며, 각 과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 공업연구관으로, 기업정책팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다. <개정 2026. 10. 20.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Industrial Policy Office shall have the Industrial Policy Division, Industrial Job Innovation Division, Industrial Environment Division, Regional Economy General Division, Regional Economy Promotion Division, Location General Division, Automotive Division, Shipbuilding & Offshore Plant Division, Engineering Design Division, Middle-sized Enterprise Policy Division, Middle-sized Enterprise Support Division, Distribution & Logistics Division, and Corporate Policy Team; the heads of each Division shall be appointed as Deputy Director-General, Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, Senior Secretary, or Research Officer for Industry, and the heads of the Corporate Policy Team shall be appointed as Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, Senior Secretary, Officer for Industry, or Officer for Administration. <Amended Oct. 20, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 산업정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑧ The Head of the Industrial Policy Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 산업정책의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 1. Formulation and Implementation of Industrial Policy

rows.source_ko: 2. 중장기 산업발전을 위한 산업발전 정책의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 2. Formulation and implementation of industrial development policies for mid-to-long-term industrial development

rows.source_ko: 3. 선진형 산업구조 구축을 위한 발전 정책의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 3. Formulation and implementation of development policies to build an advanced industrial structure

rows.source_ko: 4. 산업의 고부가가치화를 위한 산업별 대책의 수립ㆍ추진
rows.text_en: 4. Establishment and implementation of industry-specific measures for the high value-added transformation of industries

rows.source_ko: 5. 산업의 고용창출력 확대를 위한 종합정책의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 5. Establishment and implementation of comprehensive policies to expand the job creation capacity of industries

rows.source_ko: 6. 산업의 경쟁력 향상에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the improvement of industrial competitiveness

rows.source_ko: 7. 설비투자 등 실물경제의 투자 활성화에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the promotion of investment in the real economy, such as facility investment

rows.source_ko: 8. 소관 업종별 발전 정책과 지역산업 정책ㆍ기술 정책 등과의 연계에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning the linkage between development policies by relevant industry sector and regional industry policies, technology policies, etc.

rows.source_ko: 9. 주력 산업ㆍ미래유망 산업 육성 및 진흥 정책의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 9. Establishment and implementation of policies for fostering and promoting key industries and promising future industries

rows.source_ko: 10. 주력 산업ㆍ미래유망 산업 기술개발과 활용을 통한 산업의 혁신ㆍ고도화 추진 및 신산업의 창출 지원
rows.text_en: 10. Promoting industrial innovation and advancement through technology development and utilization in key industries and promising future industries, and supporting the creation of new industries

rows.source_ko: 11. 주력 산업ㆍ미래유망 산업 진흥 관련 조사ㆍ연구ㆍ홍보 및 법령ㆍ제도의 정비
rows.text_en: 11. Surveys, research, and publicity related to the promotion of key industries and promising future industries, as well as the refinement of laws and systems

rows.source_ko: 12. 주력 산업ㆍ미래유망 산업 진흥을 위한 민간협의체의 구성ㆍ운영 및 성공모델의 발굴ㆍ확산
rows.text_en: 12. Formation and operation of private-sector consultative bodies for the promotion of key industries and promising future industries, and the discovery and dissemination of successful models

rows.source_ko: 13. 주력 산업ㆍ미래유망 산업 통계기반 구축, 인력 활용 및 공급 정책의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 13. Establishment of a statistical foundation for key industries and promising future industries, and formulation and implementation of workforce utilization and supply policies

rows.source_ko: 14. 주력 산업ㆍ미래유망 산업발전기반 구축ㆍ확산과 관련한 기술개발ㆍ표준화 지원 및 사업화 촉진 등 산업기반 조성
rows.text_en: 14. Creation of an industrial foundation, including support for technology development and standardization, and promotion of commercialization, related to the establishment and expansion of a foundation for the development of key industries and promising future industries.

rows.source_ko: 15. 주력 산업ㆍ미래유망 산업발전기반 구축ㆍ확산과 관련한 업종ㆍ기업 간 협력체제 구축 및 산ㆍ학ㆍ연 협력 촉진
rows.text_en: 15. Establishment of cooperation systems between industries and companies regarding the construction and expansion of development foundations for key industries and promising future industries, and promotion of industry-academia-research cooperation

rows.source_ko: 16. 주력 산업ㆍ미래유망 산업발전기반 구축ㆍ확산을 위한 신규 비즈니스모델의 발굴 및 육성
rows.text_en: 16. Discovery and nurturing of new business models to establish and expand the foundation for the development of key industries and promising future industries

rows.source_ko: 17. 소관 업종별 경쟁력 제고 대책의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 17. Establishment and implementation of measures to enhance competitiveness by relevant industry sector

rows.source_ko: 18. 소관 업종별 중ㆍ장기 투자계획의 수립ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 18. Establishment and coordination of medium- and long-term investment plans by relevant industry sector

rows.source_ko: 19. 소관 업종별 통상 현안 관련 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 19. Overall management and coordination of trade issues by relevant industry sector

rows.source_ko: 20. 통상 정책과 업종별 통상 현안의 연계 방안 수립ㆍ조정 및 추진
rows.text_en: 20. Establishment, coordination, and implementation of measures to link trade policies with industry-specific trade issues

rows.source_ko: 21. 업종별 통상 관련 국내 이행에 관한 사항의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 21. Overall management and coordination of matters concerning domestic implementation of trade-related matters by industry

rows.source_ko: 22. 산업 정책 관련 국제기구와의 협력 및 국가 간 산업 정책 협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 22. Matters concerning cooperation with international organizations regarding industrial policy and inter-country cooperation on industrial policy

rows.source_ko: 23. 소관 산업별 국제협력 총괄ㆍ조정 및 해외진출 지원
rows.text_en: 23. Overall management and coordination of international cooperation by relevant industry and support for overseas expansion

rows.source_ko: 24. 중장기 산업발전 전망에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 24. Matters concerning mid-to-long-term industrial development prospects

rows.source_ko: 25. 지속가능 경영을 위한 기업의 사회적 책임 확대ㆍ발전에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 25. Matters concerning the expansion and development of corporate social responsibility for sustainable management

rows.source_ko: 26. 사회문제 해결형 기업의 육성ㆍ발굴에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 26. Matters concerning the fostering and identification of enterprises aimed at solving social problems

rows.source_ko: 27. 기업가 정신 고취에 관한 정책의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 27. Establishment and implementation of policies regarding the promotion of entrepreneurship

rows.source_ko: 28. 기업 금융지원기관과의 업무협조에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 28. Matters concerning business cooperation with corporate financial support institutions

rows.source_ko: 29. 「조세특례제한법」에 따른 내국세 제도의 협의에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 29. Matters concerning consultation on the domestic tax system pursuant to the Restriction of Special Taxation Act

rows.source_ko: 30. 산업 지원을 위한 관세제도 협의에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 30. Matters concerning consultation on customs systems for industrial support

rows.source_ko: 31. 경제정책조정회의 등 경제분야 대외 정책회의에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 31. Matters concerning external policy meetings in the economic sector, such as the Economic Policy Coordination Meeting

rows.source_ko: 32. 산업발전 및 상공회의소에 관한 법령ㆍ제도의 연구ㆍ개선
rows.text_en: 32. Research and improvement of laws and systems concerning industrial development and chambers of commerce

rows.source_ko: 33. 대한상공회의소 등 경제단체와의 업무 협조
rows.text_en: 33. Business cooperation with economic organizations such as the Korea Chamber of Commerce and Industry

rows.source_ko: 34. 산업통상부 소관 정책연구용역 관리시스템 운영
rows.text_en: 34. Operation of the Policy Research Service Management System under the Jurisdiction of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy

rows.source_ko: 35. 소관 단체ㆍ협회에 대한 지도 및 지원
rows.text_en: 35. Guidance and support for organizations and associations under its jurisdiction

rows.source_ko: 36. 국내외 산업경제 동향의 분석
rows.text_en: 36. Analysis of Domestic and International Industrial and Economic Trends

rows.source_ko: 37. 산업별ㆍ업종별 동향 및 장단기 전망 분석ㆍ평가
rows.text_en: 37. Analysis and Evaluation of Trends and Short- and Long-term Outlooks by Industry and Sector

rows.source_ko: 38. 설비투자 등 실물경기 동향에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 38. Matters concerning trends in the real economy, such as capital investment

rows.source_ko: 39. 주요국 실물경기 및 산업 정책 동향 분석ㆍ평가
rows.text_en: 39. Analysis and Evaluation of Real Economy and Industrial Policy Trends in Major Countries

rows.source_ko: 40. 국내외 산업 및 기업에 관한 법ㆍ제도ㆍ정책 변화의 효과 분석 및 평가
rows.text_en: 40. Analysis and Evaluation of the Effects of Changes in Laws, Systems, and Policies Concerning Domestic and International Industries and Companies

rows.source_ko: 41. 산업의 국제경쟁력 비교ㆍ분석
rows.text_en: 41. Comparative Analysis of International Competitiveness of Industries

rows.source_ko: 42. 국내외 업종별 시장의 동향 조사ㆍ분석에 관한 업무 및 정보체계 구축
rows.text_en: 42. Tasks and establishment of information systems regarding the investigation and analysis of domestic and international industry-specific market trends

rows.source_ko: 43. 업종별 기업ㆍ경영 관련 지표ㆍ동향 등의 수집ㆍ분석 및 평가
rows.text_en: 43. Collection, analysis, and evaluation of corporate and management-related indicators, trends, etc. by industry

rows.source_ko: 44. 국내외 환경변화에 따른 산업ㆍ기업 간의 상호영향 조사ㆍ분석
rows.text_en: 44. Investigation and Analysis of Mutual Impact between Industries and Companies Due to Domestic and International Environmental Changes

rows.source_ko: 45. 산업환경 변화에 따른 신규 통계 개발ㆍ연구 및 보급
rows.text_en: 45. Development, Research, and Dissemination of New Statistics in Response to Changes in the Industrial Environment

rows.source_ko: 46. 국제무역 및 통상환경 변화 등에 따른 국내 산업ㆍ업종별 영향 조사ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 46. ​​Survey and Research on the Impact of Changes in International Trade and the Trade Environment, etc., on Domestic Industries and Sectors

rows.source_ko: 47. 자유무역협정 등 통상협정의 협상ㆍ체결ㆍ이행에 따른 산업별 영향 및 효과 분석
rows.text_en: 47. Analysis of Industry-Specific Impacts and Effects of Negotiation, Conclusion, and Implementation of Trade Agreements, Including Free Trade Agreements

rows.source_ko: 48. 산업과 통상 간 정보ㆍ통계 시스템 등의 구축ㆍ연계 및 활용에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 48. Tasks concerning the establishment, linkage, and utilization of information and statistical systems, etc., between industry and trade

rows.source_ko: 49. 산업ㆍ무역ㆍ자원 및 기술개발 통계의 작성ㆍ보급 및 이용에 관한 총괄
rows.text_en: 49. Overview of the Compilation, Dissemination, and Use of Statistics on Industry, Trade, Resources, and Technological Development

rows.source_ko: 50. 정부출연연구기관 및 민간연구기관과의 산업ㆍ무역ㆍ통상ㆍ자원 분야 통계ㆍ동향의 조사ㆍ연구 및 분석에 관한 협력 업무 총괄
rows.text_en: 50. Overall management of cooperation activities regarding the investigation, research, and analysis of statistics and trends in the fields of industry, trade, commerce, and resources with government-funded research institutes and private research institutes

rows.source_ko: 51. 산업 분야 통계ㆍ동향의 조사ㆍ연구 및 분석에 관한 경제협력개발기구 및 세계무역기구 등 국제기구와의 협력 업무
rows.text_en: 51. Cooperation with international organizations, such as the OECD and the World Trade Organization, regarding the investigation, research, and analysis of statistics and trends in the industrial sector.

rows.source_ko: 52. 산업통상부와 그 소속기관의 통계 업무의 종합ㆍ조정 및 통계품질 관리에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 52. Affairs concerning the comprehensive coordination of statistical work and statistical quality management of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and its affiliated agencies

rows.source_ko: 53. 다른 통계작성기관과의 협력에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 53. Tasks regarding cooperation with other statistical agencies

rows.source_ko: 54. 산업의 구조조정 및 구조고도화에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 54. Matters concerning industrial restructuring and structural advancement

rows.source_ko: 55. 기업 구조조정 업무의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 55. Overall management and coordination of corporate restructuring operations

rows.source_ko: 56. 그 밖에 실 내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 56. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other departments within the building

rows.source_ko: ⑨ 산업일자리혁신과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑨ The Head of the Industrial Job Innovation Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 산업 분야 일자리 창출에 관한 정책의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and implementation of policies regarding job creation in the industrial sector

rows.source_ko: 2. 산업 분야 고용 동향의 분석
rows.text_en: 2. Analysis of Employment Trends in Industrial Sectors

rows.source_ko: 3. 산업 분야 노사관계 관련 동향 분석 및 제도 개선
rows.text_en: 3. Analysis of Trends in Industrial Labor-Management Relations and System Improvement

rows.source_ko: 4. 산업 분야 노사협력 및 노사문화의 개선에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the improvement of labor-management cooperation and labor-management culture in the industrial sector

rows.source_ko: 5. 산업인력의 활용ㆍ공급 관련 정책의 총괄 조정 및 성과 분석
rows.text_en: 5. Overall coordination and performance analysis of policies related to the utilization and supply of industrial workforce

rows.source_ko: 6. 산업부문별 인적자원 개발 협의체의 구성 및 운영 지원
rows.text_en: 6. Support for the formation and operation of human resource development councils by industrial sector

rows.source_ko: 7. 산업ㆍ업종별 외국인력 및 대체복무 자원 활용 정책의 지원
rows.text_en: 7. Support for policies on the utilization of foreign workforce and alternative service resources by industry and sector

rows.source_ko: 8. 산업인력 활용실태 조사 및 분석
rows.text_en: 8. Survey and Analysis of Industrial Workforce Utilization

rows.source_ko: 9. 자격 및 직무표준 관련 업무에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning duties related to qualifications and job standards

rows.source_ko: 10. 산업혁신을 위한 인력수급의 효율화 및 인력양성사업의 지원에 관한 정책의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 10. Establishment and implementation of policies regarding the efficiency of workforce supply and demand and support for workforce training programs for industrial innovation

rows.source_ko: 11. 산업별 인력 확보 및 근무환경 개선을 위한 정책의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 11. Establishment and implementation of policies for securing manpower and improving working environments by industry

rows.source_ko: 12. 산업통상부 소관 공공기관의 채용 문화 혁신을 위한 지원 정책의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 12. Establishment and implementation of support policies for innovation in recruitment culture of public institutions under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy

rows.source_ko: 13. 산업통상부 소관 산업인력 역량 강화 관련 예산의 편성 및 조정
rows.text_en: 13. Formulation and Adjustment of Budget Related to Capacity Building for Industrial Workforce under the Jurisdiction of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy

rows.source_ko: 14. 산업 분야 인력 활용ㆍ공급의 동향 분석 및 평가
rows.text_en: 14. Analysis and Evaluation of Trends in Workforce Utilization and Supply in Industrial Sectors

rows.source_ko: 15. 산업인력 정보체계의 구축 및 활성화에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 15. Matters concerning the establishment and activation of the industrial workforce information system

rows.source_ko: 16. 산업 분야 인력지원기관과의 업무 협조에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 16. Matters concerning business cooperation with industrial workforce support agencies

rows.source_ko: 17. 기업의 생산공정 혁신 지원 정책의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 17. Establishment and Implementation of Policies to Support Corporate Production Process Innovation

rows.source_ko: 18. 기업의 생산공정 혁신 고도화 정책의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 18. Establishment and Implementation of Policies for the Advancement of Corporate Production Process Innovation

rows.source_ko: 19. 기업의 생산공정 혁신 관련 기반산업 육성 정책의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 19. Establishment and implementation of policies to foster foundational industries related to corporate production process innovation

rows.source_ko: 20. 기업의 생산공정 혁신 관련 기술개발ㆍ인력양성 지원
rows.text_en: 20. Support for technology development and workforce training related to corporate production process innovation

rows.source_ko: 21. 기업의 생산공정 혁신 관련 기관과의 업무 협조
rows.text_en: 21. Business cooperation with institutions related to corporate production process innovation

rows.source_ko: 22. 생산성 향상을 위한 산업별 대책의 수립ㆍ추진
rows.text_en: 22. Establishment and implementation of industry-specific measures for productivity improvement

rows.source_ko: 23. 산업별 생산성 통계의 작성 및 생산성 동향의 분석
rows.text_en: 23. Compilation of Productivity Statistics by Industry and Analysis of Productivity Trends

rows.source_ko: 24. 생산성 향상을 위한 교육ㆍ컨설팅 지원
rows.text_en: 24. Support for training and consulting to improve productivity

rows.source_ko: 25. 국가생산성 혁신 관련 행사 및 생산성 경영체제 인증제도 운영 등 기업의 생산성 향상에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 25. Matters concerning the improvement of corporate productivity, such as events related to national productivity innovation and the operation of the productivity management system certification scheme

rows.source_ko: 26. 한국생산성본부 등 생산성 향상 관련 기관과의 업무 협조
rows.text_en: 26. Business cooperation with productivity improvement-related organizations, such as the Korea Productivity Center

rows.source_ko: 27. 생산성 향상 관련 국내외 기업ㆍ단체 간의 협력 지원
rows.text_en: 27. Support for cooperation between domestic and international companies and organizations regarding productivity improvement

rows.source_ko: ⑩ 산업환경과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 10. The Head of the Industrial Environment Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 「환경친화적 산업구조로의 전환촉진에 관한 법률」의 운영
rows.text_en: 1. Operation of the "Act on the Promotion of Transition to an Environmentally Friendly Industrial Structure"

rows.source_ko: 2. 환경친화적 산업발전에 관한 종합정책의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment and implementation of comprehensive policies on environmentally friendly industrial development

rows.source_ko: 3. 산업계의 청정생산기술 개발ㆍ보급 촉진에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the promotion of development and dissemination of clean production technologies in the industrial sector

rows.source_ko: 4. 환경설비제조 산업의 육성 및 신환경산업(Green Ocean)의 기술개발ㆍ시장수요 창출ㆍ사업화 지원
rows.text_en: 4. Fostering the environmental equipment manufacturing industry and supporting technology development, market demand creation, and commercialization of the new environmental industry (Green Ocean)

rows.source_ko: 5. 청정생산 지원을 위한 협의회, 컨설팅사업 육성을 위한 심의회 운영 및 녹색경영 관련 기관과의 협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the operation of a council to support clean production and a deliberation committee to foster consulting businesses, and cooperation with green management-related institutions

rows.source_ko: 6. 바젤협약 등 국제환경협약에 따른 제도 운영 및 국제환경규범에 대한 국내 산업계 대응 정책의 추진
rows.text_en: 6. Operation of systems pursuant to international environmental agreements such as the Basel Convention and implementation of policies for the domestic industry's response to international environmental norms

rows.source_ko: 7. 기업의 EU 신화학물질관리제도(REACH) 대응 지원을 위한 국내기업의 화학물질 등록 지원 및 전문인력 양성
rows.text_en: 7. Support for domestic companies' chemical registration and training of specialized personnel to assist in their response to the EU’s new chemical management system (REACH)

rows.source_ko: 8. 기업의 환경친화적 제품 생산 촉진을 위한 친환경설계 및 제품 온실가스 배출량 표시제도 운영
rows.text_en: 8. Operation of eco-friendly design and product greenhouse gas emission labeling systems to promote the production of eco-friendly products by companies

rows.source_ko: 9. 녹색경영 방법론 개발ㆍ보급, 녹색경영 전문컨설턴트 양성 및 녹색경영 관련 시상(施賞) 등 기업의 녹색경영 촉진 기반 조성
rows.text_en: 9. Establishing a foundation for promoting corporate green management, including the development and dissemination of green management methodologies, the training of professional green management consultants, and the awarding of green management-related prizes.

rows.source_ko: 10. 청정컨설팅 및 제품서비스화 사업 등 환경 친화적 서비스산업의 육성에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning the promotion of environmentally friendly service industries, such as clean consulting and product service commercialization businesses

rows.source_ko: 11. 중소기업의 녹색경영 도입 촉진을 위한 대ㆍ중소기업 간 환경 분야 상생협력 활성화 및 녹색경영ㆍ청정생산 관련 진단ㆍ지도
rows.text_en: 11. Activation of win-win cooperation in the environmental sector between large and small businesses to promote the adoption of green management in SMEs, and diagnosis and guidance related to green management and clean production

rows.source_ko: 12. 천연자원과 순환자원의 통합관리체계 구축ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 12. Establishment and Operation of an Integrated Management System for Natural and Circular Resources

rows.source_ko: 13. 자원생산성 혁신기술 개발ㆍ보급 및 중소기업 자원생산성 진단ㆍ지도
rows.text_en: 13. Development and dissemination of innovative technologies for resource productivity and diagnosis and guidance of resource productivity for SMEs

rows.source_ko: 14. 재제조(再製造) 산업 발전계획의 수립 및 산업계 재제조 촉진에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 14. Matters concerning the establishment of a development plan for the remanufacturing industry and the promotion of remanufacturing in the industrial sector

rows.source_ko: 15. 산업계의 자원재활용 및 폐기물관리대책의 수립ㆍ추진
rows.text_en: 15. Establishment and implementation of resource recycling and waste management measures in the industrial sector

rows.source_ko: 16. 생태산업단지 지정ㆍ운영 및 생태산업개발 촉진
rows.text_en: 16. Designation and Operation of Eco-Industrial Parks and Promotion of Eco-Industrial Development

rows.source_ko: 17. 「전기ㆍ전자제품 및 자동차의 자원순환에 관한 법률」의 소관 분야 운영
rows.text_en: 17. Operation of the relevant sector under the "Act on Resource Recycling of Electrical and Electronic Products and Automobiles"

rows.source_ko: 18. 산업환경 과제 발굴 및 기업 관련 환경규제 합리화 방안에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 18. Matters concerning the identification of industrial environmental challenges and measures for the rationalization of corporate-related environmental regulations

rows.source_ko: 19. 국제연합공업개발기구(UNIDO), 유엔지속개발위원회(UNCSD), 경제협력개발기구(OECD) 등의 산업환경 정책 관련 대응 및 국내 이행에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 19. Matters concerning responses to and domestic implementation of industrial and environmental policies of the United Nations Industrial Development Organization (UNIDO), the United Nations Commission on Sustainable Development (UNCSD), the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD), etc.

rows.source_ko: 20. 중국ㆍ베트남 등 해외 진출 기업의 환경법규 이행을 위한 녹색경영 도입 지원
rows.text_en: 20. Support for the introduction of green management to ensure compliance with environmental regulations for companies expanding overseas, including in China and Vietnam

rows.source_ko: 21. 산업환경 동향 분석, 산업환경정보망 및 산업환경통계체제 구축
rows.text_en: 21. Analysis of industrial environment trends, establishment of industrial environment information network and industrial environment statistics system

rows.source_ko: 22. 청정생산지원센터의 지정 및 운영
rows.text_en: 22. Designation and Operation of the Clean Production Support Center

rows.source_ko: 23. 청정생산 설비의 투자사업에 대한 자금 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 23. Matters concerning financial support for investment projects in clean production facilities

rows.source_ko: 24. 환경산업의 투자 활성화 및 금융 등 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 24. Matters concerning the promotion of investment in the environmental industry and support, including finance.

rows.source_ko: 25. 산업 부문 탄소중립ㆍ녹색성장 정책 추진 총괄
rows.text_en: 25. Overall Management of Carbon Neutrality and Green Growth Policies in the Industrial Sector

rows.source_ko: 26. 산업부문 탄소중립 전환을 위한 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 26. Matters concerning support for the transition to carbon neutrality in the industrial sector

rows.source_ko: 27. 청정생산사업장의 구축과 확산에 대한 시책 수립
rows.text_en: 27. Establishment of policies for the establishment and expansion of clean production workplaces

rows.source_ko: 28. 산업 부문의 순환경제 촉진을 위한 시책 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 28. Establishment and implementation of policies to promote the circular economy in the industrial sector

rows.source_ko: 29. 금속자원의 재자원화를 위한 지원
rows.text_en: 29. Support for the recycling of metal resources

rows.source_ko: 30. 산업 분야의 온실가스 감축 활성화를 위한 금융ㆍ세제상의 지원 및 제도 개선
rows.text_en: 30. Financial and tax support and institutional improvements to promote greenhouse gas reduction in the industrial sector

rows.source_ko: 31. 산업 분야 기후변화 대응 및 온실가스 감축에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 31. Matters concerning climate change response and greenhouse gas reduction in the industrial sector

rows.source_ko: 32. 산업 분야의 온실가스 감축에 관한 기본계획 수립ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 32. Establishment and coordination of basic plans for greenhouse gas reduction in the industrial sector

rows.source_ko: 33. 자발적 협약, 정부협약 등 산업체 온실가스 감축 및 정책의 수립
rows.text_en: 33. Formulation of policies and greenhouse gas reduction by industries, including voluntary agreements and government agreements

rows.source_ko: 34. 산업 분야의 온실가스 감축 관련 정책의 개발
rows.text_en: 34. Development of Greenhouse Gas Reduction Policies in the Industrial Sector

rows.source_ko: 35. 산업 분야 기업의 온실가스 감축 목표 수립 및 이행 지원을 위한 배출량 할당 방식의 탄소시장 운영
rows.text_en: 35. Operation of a carbon market using an emissions allocation method to support the establishment and implementation of greenhouse gas reduction targets for industrial companies

rows.source_ko: 36. 산업 분야 탄소배출권 거래제 관련 지원 사업
rows.text_en: 36. Support Programs Related to the Carbon Emission Trading System in the Industrial Sector

rows.source_ko: 37. 산업 분야의 온실가스 감축수단ㆍ기술 조사 및 감축잠재량 분석
rows.text_en: 37. Survey of Greenhouse Gas Reduction Means and Technologies in the Industrial Sector and Analysis of Reduction Potential

rows.source_ko: 38. 산업 분야의 온실가스 감축 목표 이행 실적 점검을 위한 평가체계 수립 및 진단보고서 작성
rows.text_en: 38. Establishment of an evaluation system and preparation of diagnostic reports to monitor the implementation of greenhouse gas reduction targets in the industrial sector

rows.source_ko: 39. 산업 분야 온실가스의 배출통계 산정, 배출계수 및 산정지침의 개발
rows.text_en: 39. Calculation of greenhouse gas emission statistics in the industrial sector, and development of emission factors and calculation guidelines

rows.source_ko: 40. 산업 분야 온실가스 총배출량 통계의 작성ㆍ관리, 산업 부문 온실가스 배출통계ㆍ정보의 구축 및 배출 기준 설정
rows.text_en: 40. Compilation and management of total greenhouse gas emission statistics in the industrial sector, establishment of greenhouse gas emission statistics and information for the industrial sector, and setting of emission standards

rows.source_ko: 41. 산업 분야 온실가스 감축을 위한 프로그램 개발 및 보급
rows.text_en: 41. Development and dissemination of programs for greenhouse gas reduction in the industrial sector

rows.source_ko: 42. 산업 분야 온실가스 감축사업 등록 기업을 위한 인센티브 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 42. Matters concerning incentive support for companies registered for greenhouse gas reduction projects in the industrial sector

rows.source_ko: 43. 산업 분야 배출권거래제 관련 외부사업 온실가스 감축량의 등록ㆍ평가ㆍ검증ㆍ인증 등 상쇄제도 운영
rows.text_en: 43. Operation of offset systems, such as registration, evaluation, verification, and certification of greenhouse gas reductions from external projects related to the industrial sector emissions trading scheme

rows.source_ko: 44. 「온실가스 배출권의 할당 및 거래에 관한 법률 시행령」 제8조에 따른 배출권거래제 협의체와 관련된 사항
rows.text_en: 44. Matters related to the Emissions Trading Scheme Consultative Body pursuant to Article 8 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Allocation and Trading of Greenhouse Gas Emission Allowances

rows.source_ko: 45. 산업 분야 온실가스 배출업체의 실태 조사에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 45. Matters concerning the investigation of the status of greenhouse gas emitters in the industrial sector

rows.source_ko: 46. 산업 분야의 기후변화 적응 대책의 수립
rows.text_en: 46. ​​Establishment of Climate Change Adaptation Measures in the Industrial Sector

rows.source_ko: 47. 산업 분야의 기후변화 대응에 관한 기본계획의 수립
rows.text_en: 47. Establishment of a basic plan for climate change response in the industrial sector

rows.source_ko: 48. 에너지 다소비 업종을 중심으로 한 산업계 업종별 대책반 운영 등 기업의 자발적 온실가스 감축 목표 수립 및 이행을 위한 제도 지원
rows.text_en: 48. Institutional support for the establishment and implementation of voluntary greenhouse gas reduction targets by companies, such as the operation of industry-specific task forces focusing on energy-intensive sectors.

rows.source_ko: 49. 산업 분야 관리업체 지정ㆍ관리 및 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 49. Matters concerning the designation, management, and support of management companies in the industrial sector

rows.source_ko: 50. 산업 분야 온실가스 목표관리제도의 운영 및 관련 정책의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 50. Operation of the Greenhouse Gas Target Management System in the Industrial Sector and Establishment and Implementation of Related Policies

rows.source_ko: 51. 산업 분야 온실가스 목표관리업체의 지정ㆍ관리 및 재정ㆍ기술 등 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 51. Matters concerning the designation and management of greenhouse gas target management companies in the industrial sector, as well as financial, technical, and other support

rows.source_ko: 52. 산업 분야 온실가스 목표관리업체의 감축목표 설정ㆍ관리 및 점검ㆍ평가
rows.text_en: 52. Setting, Management, Monitoring, and Evaluation of Reduction Targets for Greenhouse Gas Target Management Companies in the Industrial Sector

rows.source_ko: 53. 산업 분야 온실가스 목표관리업체의 조기 감축 실적의 인정 및 대ㆍ중소기업 간 감축협력사업의 운영 등에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 53. Matters concerning the recognition of early reduction achievements of greenhouse gas target management entities in the industrial sector and the operation of reduction cooperation projects between large and small and medium-sized enterprises

rows.source_ko: 54. 온실가스 감축사업에 투자하는 산업 분야 탄소펀드 조성 및 운영
rows.text_en: 54. Establishment and Operation of Carbon Funds in Industrial Sectors Investing in Greenhouse Gas Reduction Projects

rows.source_ko: 55. 기후변화 특성화 대학원 운영 등 기후변화 대응 관련 산업ㆍ통상부문 전문인력 양성
rows.text_en: 55. Fostering specialized personnel in the industrial and trade sectors related to climate change response, including the operation of graduate schools specializing in climate change

rows.source_ko: 56. 산업ㆍ기업 관련 에너지 정책ㆍ제도에 대한 의견 수렴, 산업계 영향 분석 등 대응 및 협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 56. Matters concerning response and cooperation, such as gathering opinions on energy policies and systems related to industry and enterprises and analyzing the impact on the industrial sector

rows.source_ko: 57. 에너지 관련 부처ㆍ기관과의 업무 협조 및 정책ㆍ제도 개선
rows.text_en: 57. Business cooperation with energy-related ministries and agencies and improvement of policies and systems

rows.source_ko: ⑪ 지역경제총괄과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 11 The Head of the Regional Economy Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 지역경제정책 및 산업정책의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 1. Formulation and implementation of regional economic and industrial policies

rows.source_ko: 2. 특별시ㆍ광역시ㆍ특별자치시ㆍ도ㆍ특별자치도(이하 “시ㆍ도”라 한다)별 지역경제 활성화 정책의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment and implementation of regional economic revitalization policies by Special City, Metropolitan City, Special Self-Governing City, Province, and Special Self-Governing Province (hereinafter referred to as “City/Province”)

rows.source_ko: 3. 「지방자치분권 및 지역균형발전에 관한 특별법」의 운영
rows.text_en: 3. Operation of the Special Act on Local Autonomy and Balanced Regional Development

rows.source_ko: 4. 지방시대 종합계획의 수립 총괄
rows.text_en: 4. Overall Management of the Establishment of the Comprehensive Plan for the Local Era

rows.source_ko: 5. 산업통상부 소관 지방시대 부문별 계획 및 시행계획의 수립ㆍ평가 총괄
rows.text_en: 5. Overall management of the formulation and evaluation of sectoral plans and implementation plans for local governments under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy

rows.source_ko: 6. 지역경제정책 및 산업 관련 법령ㆍ제도의 연구ㆍ개선
rows.text_en: 6. Research and improvement of regional economic policies and industry-related laws and systems

rows.source_ko: 7. 시ㆍ도 경제ㆍ산업동향 분석ㆍ평가에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the analysis and evaluation of economic and industrial trends in cities and provinces

rows.source_ko: 8. 지역경제ㆍ산업 관련 통계 등 지역정보기반 구축에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning the establishment of a regional information infrastructure, such as statistics related to the regional economy and industry

rows.source_ko: 9. 지역경제 관련 해외 교류협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning overseas exchange and cooperation related to the regional economy

rows.source_ko: 10. 시ㆍ도의 민ㆍ관 네트워크 구축에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning the establishment of public-private networks in cities and provinces

rows.source_ko: 11. 지역산업지원사업의 조정ㆍ연계 및 운영 효율화에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Matters concerning the coordination, linkage, and operational efficiency of regional industry support projects

rows.source_ko: 12. 지방시대 종합계획 연차보고서의 작성에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 12. Matters concerning the preparation of the Annual Report of the Comprehensive Plan for the Local Era

rows.source_ko: 13. 산업통상부 소관 지역균형발전특별회계의 운용
rows.text_en: 13. Operation of the Special Account for Balanced Regional Development under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy

rows.source_ko: 14. 산업통상부 소관 공공기관의 지방이전에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 14. Matters concerning the relocation of public institutions under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy to provincial areas

rows.source_ko: 15. 시ㆍ도 지방시대 계획의 수립ㆍ운영 등에 대한 지원
rows.text_en: 15. Support for the establishment and operation of city and provincial local era plans

rows.source_ko: 16. 지방시대기획단의 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 16. Matters concerning support for the Local Era Planning Group

rows.source_ko: 17. 지방시대위원회의 예산 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 17. Matters concerning the budget management of the Local Government Era Committee

rows.source_ko: 18. 시ㆍ도 지방시대위원회의 예산 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 18. Matters concerning the budget management of City/Provincial Local Government Commissions

rows.source_ko: 19. 지역 혁신체계 구축을 위한 산ㆍ학ㆍ연 협력의 활성화에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 19. Matters concerning the promotion of industry-academia-research cooperation for the establishment of a regional innovation system

rows.source_ko: 20. 지역의 기업지원 서비스기관에 대한 지원
rows.text_en: 20. Support for local business support service agencies

rows.source_ko: 제10조(산업성장실) ① 산업성장실장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Industrial Growth Office) ① The Head of the Industrial Growth Office shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A.

rows.source_ko: ② 「산업통상부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제13조제1항에 따라 산업성장실장 밑에 두는 보좌기관은 산업기술융합정책관ㆍ산업인공지능정책관 및 첨단산업정책관으로 하며, 산업기술융합정책관ㆍ산업인공지능정책관 및 첨단산업정책관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: ② Pursuant to Article 13, Paragraph 1 of the “Organization of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and its Affiliated Agencies,” the advisory bodies placed under the Director of the Industrial Growth Office shall be the Director of Industrial Technology Convergence Policy, the Director of Industrial Artificial Intelligence Policy, and the Director of Advanced Industry Policy; the Director of Industrial Technology Convergence Policy, the Director of Industrial Artificial Intelligence Policy, and the Director of Advanced Industry Policy shall be appointed as general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ③ 산업기술융합정책관은 「산업통상부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제13조제3항제1호부터 제18호까지의 사항에 관하여 실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Director of Industrial Technology Convergence Policy assists the Director with matters under subparagraphs 1 through 18 of Article 13, Paragraph 3 of the “Organization of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and its Affiliated Agencies.”

rows.source_ko: ④ 산업인공지능정책관은 「산업통상부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제13조제3항제19호부터 제31호까지의 사항에 관하여 실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Director of Industrial Artificial Intelligence Policy assists the Director with respect to matters under subparagraphs 19 through 31 of Article 13, Paragraph 3 of the “Organization of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and its Affiliated Agencies.”

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 첨단산업정책관은 「산업통상부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제13조제3항제32호부터 제34호까지, 제34호의2 및 제35호부터 제51호까지의 사항에 관하여 실장을 보좌한다. <개정 2026. 10. 20.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Director General for Advanced Industry Policy assists the Director General with respect to matters under Article 13, Paragraph 3 , Subparagraphs 32 through 34 , 34-2, and 35 through 51 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and Its Affiliated Agencies. ” <Amended Oct. 20, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 산업성장실에 산업기술정책과ㆍ산업기술시장과ㆍ산업규제혁신과ㆍ산업인공지능정책과ㆍ인공지능기계로봇과ㆍ인공지능바이오융합산업과ㆍ배터리전기전자과ㆍ첨단민군협력과ㆍ섬유탄소나노과 및 디스플레이가전팀을 두되, 각 과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 공업연구관으로, 디스플레이가전팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다. <개정 2026. 10. 20.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Industrial Growth Office shall establish the Industrial Technology Policy Division, Industrial Technology Market Division, Industrial Regulation Innovation Division, Industrial AI Policy Division, AI Machinery & Robotics Division, AI Bio-Convergence Industry Division, Battery Electrical & Electronics Division, Advanced Civil-Military Cooperation Division, Textile, Carbon & Nanotechnology Division, and the Display & Home Appliances Team; provided that the heads of each division shall be appointed as Deputy Director-General, Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, Senior Secretary, or Industrial Research Officer, and the heads of the Display & Home Appliances Team shall be appointed as Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, Senior Secretary, Industrial Officer, or Administrative Officer. <Amended Oct. 20, 2026>

rows.text_en: 10. The Head of the Industrial Artificial Intelligence Policy Division is responsible for the following matters.
