rows.source_ko: 러. 장례식장ㆍ병원ㆍ산후조리원ㆍ유치원 등 보건ㆍ복지ㆍ교육ㆍ공공 관련 서비스
rows.text_en: Russia. Health, welfare, education, and public services such as funeral homes, hospitals, postpartum care centers, and kindergartens

rows.source_ko: 머. 사회적 책임, 지속가능경영, 사회안전시스템 및 범죄예방환경설계
rows.text_en: M. Social responsibility, sustainable management, social safety systems, and crime prevention through environmental design

rows.source_ko: 버. 품질경영, 프로젝트 경영 및 적합성평가
rows.text_en: B. Quality Management, Project Management, and Conformity Assessment

rows.source_ko: 서. 고령자 및 장애인 복지관련 서비스, 인간공학적 디자인 및 접근성 향상을 위한 디자인
rows.text_en: S. Welfare-related services for the elderly and persons with disabilities, ergonomic design, and design for improving accessibility

rows.source_ko: 어. 의류 및 산업용 섬유, 섬유 염색ㆍ가공 기술, 보호복 및 보호장구
rows.text_en: Uh. Clothing and industrial textiles, textile dyeing and processing technology, protective clothing and protective equipment

rows.source_ko: 저. 가죽ㆍ가구ㆍ문구ㆍ레저ㆍ스포츠 등 생활용품 및 시설
rows.text_en: I. Household goods and facilities including leather, furniture, stationery, leisure, and sports

rows.source_ko: 처. 바이오 제품 및 장비 등 바이오 응용기술
rows.text_en: Department. Bio-applied technologies such as bio-products and equipment

rows.source_ko: ⑨ 국제표준화기구전략대응팀장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑨ The Head of the International Standardization Organization Strategic Response Team is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 국제표준화 대응 전략 수립ㆍ지원
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and support of strategies for responding to international standardization

rows.source_ko: 2. 국제표준화기구 이사회, 상임위원회, 정책개발위원회 등 주요 정책위원회 대응 전략 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment and implementation of response strategies for major policy committees, such as the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) Board of Directors, Standing Committee, and Policy Development Committee

rows.source_ko: 3. 국제표준화기구 정책 방향 분석ㆍ자문ㆍ대응을 위한 전문가 자문위원회 구성ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 3. Formation and operation of an expert advisory committee for the analysis, consultation, and response to the policy directions of the International Organization for Standardization (ISO)

rows.source_ko: 4. 탄소중립 등 신산업분야 국제표준 선점을 위한 전문인력ㆍ신규과제 발굴 및 대응전략 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 4. Identification of specialized personnel and new projects, and establishment and implementation of response strategies to secure international standards in new industrial sectors such as carbon neutrality

rows.source_ko: 5. 국제표준화기구 상임이사국 진출을 위한 세부 추진전략 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 5. Establishment and implementation of detailed strategies for securing a permanent seat on the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) Executive Board

rows.source_ko: 6. 제1호부터 제5호까지의 업무에 관한 국내외 관계 기관과의 협조
rows.text_en: 6. Cooperation with relevant domestic and foreign organizations regarding the tasks under Items 1 through 5

rows.source_ko: 제20조(제품안전정책국) ① 제품안전정책국장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직ㆍ공업연구관ㆍ환경연구관ㆍ시설연구관 또는 보건연구관으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 20 (Product Safety Policy Bureau) ① The Director of the Product Safety Policy Bureau shall be appointed from among general officials, industrial research officers, environmental research officers, facility research officers, or health research officers belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of such position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 제품안전정책국에 제품안전정책과ㆍ제품시장관리과ㆍ제품안전정보과ㆍ전기통신제품안전과 및 생활어린이제품안전과를 두되, 제품안전정책과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업연구관ㆍ환경연구관ㆍ시설연구관 또는 보건연구관으로, 제품시장관리과장ㆍ제품안전정보과장ㆍ전기통신제품안전과장 및 생활어린이제품안전과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업연구관ㆍ환경연구관ㆍ시설연구관 또는 보건연구관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Product Safety Policy Bureau shall have the Product Safety Policy Division, Product Market Management Division, Product Safety Information Division, Telecommunications Product Safety Division, and Household & Children Product Safety Division; the head of the Product Safety Policy Division shall be appointed as a Deputy Director, Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Industrial Research Officer, Environmental Research Officer, Facilities Research Officer, or Health Research Officer, and the heads of the Product Market Management Division, Product Safety Information Division, Telecommunications Product Safety Division, and Household & Children Product Safety Division shall be appointed as Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Industrial Research Officer, Environmental Research Officer, Facilities Research Officer, or Health Research Officer.

rows.source_ko: ③ 제품안전정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Product Safety Policy Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 제품[생활용품, 어린이제품 및 전기용품(정보통신제품 및 전기통신기기 등의 제품을 포함한다)을 말한다. 이하 이 장에서 같다]의 안전(정보통신제품 및 전기통신기기 등의 제품은 전기안전에 한정한다) 및 품질관리에 관한 종합계획의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management and coordination of comprehensive plans regarding the safety (limited to electrical safety for information and communication products and telecommunication devices, etc.) and quality management of products [referring to household goods, children's products, and electrical products (including products such as information and communication products and telecommunication devices, etc.; hereinafter the same applies in this Chapter].

rows.source_ko: 2. 안전취약계층 보호 및 지원대책의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Overall management and coordination of protection and support measures for safety-vulnerable groups

rows.source_ko: 3. 제품안전 전문인력 양성ㆍ교육에 관한 정책의 수립ㆍ추진
rows.text_en: 3. Establishment and implementation of policies regarding the training and education of product safety specialists

rows.source_ko: 4. 제품안전분야 유공자 및 단체 포상에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning awards for individuals and organizations of merit in the field of product safety

rows.source_ko: 5. 제품안전에 관한 정책의 수립ㆍ추진
rows.text_en: 5. Establishment and implementation of policies regarding product safety

rows.source_ko: 6. 제품안전 기술개발 및 안전관리 등 관련 지원
rows.text_en: 6. Support related to product safety technology development and safety management, etc.

rows.source_ko: 7. 제품안전에 관한 법령ㆍ제도의 연구ㆍ개선
rows.text_en: 7. Research and improvement of laws and systems regarding product safety

rows.source_ko: 8. 제품안전 관련 국제기구와의 교류ㆍ협력 지원
rows.text_en: 8. Support for exchange and cooperation with international organizations related to product safety

rows.source_ko: 9. 제품안전 관련 기관 및 소비자단체ㆍ시민단체ㆍ사업자단체 등과의 업무협력
rows.text_en: 9. Business cooperation with product safety-related agencies, consumer groups, civic groups, business associations, etc.

rows.source_ko: 10. 유통 제품의 안전성 확보를 위한 예방적 안전관리시책 수립ㆍ추진
rows.text_en: 10. Establishment and implementation of preventive safety management measures to ensure the safety of distributed products

rows.source_ko: 11. 제품안전 관련 법령에 관한 사항 및 제품안전 관련 법인 및 협회의 관리ㆍ감독에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Matters concerning laws and regulations related to product safety and matters concerning the management and supervision of corporations and associations related to product safety

rows.source_ko: 12. 제품안전 관련 기업지원 사업 운영
rows.text_en: 12. Operation of corporate support programs related to product safety

rows.source_ko: 13.제품안전정책협의회 구성ㆍ운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 13. Matters concerning the composition and operation of the Product Safety Policy Council

rows.source_ko: 14. 그 밖에 제품안전정책국 내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 아니하는 사항
rows.text_en: 14. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other divisions within the Product Safety Policy Bureau

rows.source_ko: ④ 제품시장관리과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Product Market Management Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 제품의 안전모니터링에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning product safety monitoring

rows.source_ko: 2. 제품의 안전성 조사에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning product safety investigation

rows.source_ko: 3. 제품에 대한 안전성조사 관련 자문위원회 운영
rows.text_en: 3. Operation of the Advisory Committee on Product Safety Investigations

rows.source_ko: 4. 제품의 안전관리에 대한 사업자 보고 및 검사
rows.text_en: 4. Business operator reporting and inspection regarding product safety management

rows.source_ko: 5. 제품의 안전관리와 관련한 시ㆍ도와의 협력
rows.text_en: 5. Cooperation with Cities and Provinces regarding product safety management

rows.source_ko: 6. 제품의 안전성 확보를 위한 제품 수거 등의 안전관리시책 수립
rows.text_en: 6. Establishment of safety management measures, such as product recall, to ensure product safety

rows.source_ko: 7. 안전성조사 제품 수거 등의 권고 및 명령 등 조치에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning measures such as recommendations and orders for product recall following safety investigations

rows.source_ko: 8. 제품 수거 등의 방법 및 절차 등에 대한 검토 및 사업자와의 협의에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning the review of methods and procedures for product collection, etc., and consultation with the business operator

rows.source_ko: 9. 제품 수거 등의 조치 이행에 대한 모니터링
rows.text_en: 9. Monitoring of the implementation of measures such as product recall

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 제품안전정보과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Product Safety Information Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 제품 위해성에 관한 국내외 정보 수집
rows.text_en: 1. Collection of domestic and international information regarding product risks

rows.source_ko: 2. 제품사고에 대한 경위 및 원인 등 조사ㆍ분석
rows.text_en: 2. Investigation and analysis of the circumstances and causes of product accidents

rows.source_ko: 3. 제품사고 시 사업자의 보고 및 그 처리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the business operator's reporting and handling of product accidents

rows.source_ko: 4. 사고조사제품 수거 등의 권고 및 명령 등 조치에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning measures such as recommendations and orders for the collection of accident investigation products

rows.source_ko: 5. 제품 위해정보의 분석 및 평가
rows.text_en: 5. Analysis and Evaluation of Product Hazard Information

rows.source_ko: 6. 제품 위해정보 전파, 교류 및 대외협력 등 관리
rows.text_en: 6. Management of dissemination, exchange, and external cooperation regarding product hazard information

rows.source_ko: 7. 제품 위해정보 활용 및 관리를 위한 계획의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 7. Establishment and implementation of plans for the utilization and management of product hazard information

rows.source_ko: 8. 제품 위해정보 수집ㆍ분석체계의 구축 및 기법 개발
rows.text_en: 8. Establishment of a Product Hazard Information Collection and Analysis System and Development of Techniques

rows.source_ko: 9. 기업ㆍ소비자 등에 제품 위해정보 사전예방적 소통활동 및 교육 프로그램 운영
rows.text_en: 9. Operation of proactive communication activities and education programs regarding product hazards for businesses, consumers, etc.

rows.source_ko: 10. 안전인증ㆍ리콜 정보 등 제품안전 통계관리를 위한 통합 자료 구축ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 10. Establishment and operation of integrated data for product safety statistical management, including safety certification and recall information

rows.source_ko: 11. 제품안전 정보망의 구축 및 운영
rows.text_en: 11. Establishment and Operation of Product Safety Information Network

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 전기통신제품안전과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Head of the Telecommunications Product Safety Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 전기용품에 관한 안전관리정책 및 시행계획의 수립ㆍ운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the establishment and operation of safety management policies and implementation plans regarding electrical appliances

rows.source_ko: 2. 전기용품에 관한 법령 및 제도의 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the operation of laws and systems related to electrical appliances

rows.source_ko: 3. 국제전기기기인증제도(IECEE)에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the International Electrotechnical Commission Certification Scheme (IECEE)

rows.source_ko: 4. 안전인증대상, 안전확인대상, 공급자적합성확인대상, 전기용품의 지정 및 전기용품의 인증에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning subjects subject to safety certification, subjects subject to safety verification, subjects subject to supplier conformity verification, designation of electrical products, and certification of electrical products

rows.source_ko: 5. 전기용품의 안전기준의 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the operation of safety standards for electrical appliances

rows.source_ko: 6. 전기용품의 안전인증기관 및 시험기관의 지정ㆍ관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the designation and management of safety certification bodies and testing laboratories for electrical products

rows.source_ko: 7. 전기용품 안전 관련 국제기구와의 교류ㆍ협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning exchange and cooperation with international organizations related to electrical product safety

rows.source_ko: 8. 전기용품의 무역기술장벽 대응 업무의 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning support for work on responding to trade technical barriers for electrical products

rows.source_ko: 9. 전기용품의 상호인정협정업무 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning support for mutual recognition agreements for electrical products

rows.source_ko: 10. 전기용품전문위원회 등 소관 법령에 따른 위원회의 구성ㆍ운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning the composition and operation of committees under relevant laws, such as the Expert Committee on Electrical Appliances

rows.source_ko: 11. 전기용품의 안전과 관련된 협회 등의 기관ㆍ단체의 관리와 업무 협조
rows.text_en: 11. Management and cooperation with institutions and organizations, such as associations, related to the safety of electrical appliances

rows.source_ko: 12. 그 밖에 전기용품의 안전관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 12. Other matters concerning the safety management of electrical appliances

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 생활어린이제품안전과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Head of the Household and Children's Product Safety Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 생활용품ㆍ어린이제품 안전관리정책 및 시행계획의 수립ㆍ운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the establishment and operation of safety management policies and implementation plans for household goods and children's products

rows.source_ko: 2. 고령자 제품의 안전관리대책의 수립ㆍ추진
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment and implementation of safety management measures for products for the elderly

rows.source_ko: 3. 생활용품ㆍ어린이제품 안전관리에 관한 법령 및 제도의 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the operation of laws and systems regarding the safety management of household goods and children's products

rows.source_ko: 4. 안전인증, 안전확인, 공급자적합성확인, 안전기준준수 및 어린이보호포장 대상 생활용품의 지정과 안전인증, 안전확인, 공급자적합성확인 대상 어린이제품의 지정에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the designation of household goods subject to safety certification, safety verification, supplier conformity verification, safety standard compliance, and child-resistant packaging, and the designation of children's products subject to safety certification, safety verification, and supplier conformity verification

rows.source_ko: 5. 생활용품ㆍ어린이제품 안전기준의 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the operation of safety standards for household goods and children's products

rows.source_ko: 6. 생활용품ㆍ어린이제품 안전인증기관의 지정ㆍ관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the designation and management of safety certification bodies for household goods and children's products

rows.source_ko: 7. 안전확인대상 생활용품 및 안전확인대상 어린이제품의 시험ㆍ검사기관의 지정ㆍ관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the designation and management of testing and inspection institutions for household goods subject to safety verification and children's products subject to safety verification

rows.source_ko: 8. 생활용품ㆍ어린이제품 안전 관련 국제기구의 안전기준의 제ㆍ개정 참여 및 교류ㆍ협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning participation in the enactment and revision of safety standards of international organizations related to the safety of household goods and children's products, as well as exchange and cooperation

rows.source_ko: 9. 생활용품ㆍ어린이제품의 무역기술장벽 대응업무 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning support for responding to trade technical barriers for household goods and children's products

rows.source_ko: 10. 생활용품ㆍ어린이제품의 상호인정협정업무 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning support for mutual recognition agreements for household goods and children's products

rows.source_ko: 11. 제품안전심의위원회 등 관련 위원회의 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Matters concerning the operation of relevant committees, such as the Product Safety Deliberation Committee

rows.source_ko: 12. 아동정책조정위원회 등 생활용품ㆍ어린이제품 안전 관련 기관 및 단체와의 업무협조
rows.text_en: 12. Business cooperation with agencies and organizations related to the safety of household goods and children's products, such as the Child Policy Coordination Committee

rows.source_ko: 13. 소비자단체 및 시민단체와의 협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 13. Matters concerning cooperation with consumer and civic groups

rows.source_ko: 14. 어린이제품 안전친화기업 지정ㆍ관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 14. Matters concerning the designation and management of child product safety-friendly companies

rows.source_ko: 15. 안전한 어린이제품 제조ㆍ유통에 대한 장려 및 지원에 대한 사항
rows.text_en: 15. Matters concerning the encouragement and support of the manufacturing and distribution of safe children's products

rows.source_ko: 16. 그 밖에 생활용품ㆍ어린이제품의 안전관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 16. Other matters concerning the safety management of household goods and children's products

rows.source_ko: 제21조(적합성정책국) ① 적합성정책국장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원ㆍ공업연구관ㆍ환경연구관ㆍ시설연구관 또는 보건연구관으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 21 (Conformity Policy Bureau) ① The Director of the Conformity Policy Bureau shall be appointed from among general civil servants, industrial research officers, environmental research officers, facility research officers, or health research officers belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of such position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 적합성정책국에 시험인증정책과ㆍ적합성평가과ㆍ인증산업진흥과 및 계량측정제도과를 두되, 시험인증정책과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업연구관ㆍ환경연구관ㆍ시설연구관 또는 보건연구관으로, 적합성평가과장, 인증산업진흥과장 및 계량측정제도과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업연구관ㆍ환경연구관ㆍ시설연구관 또는 보건연구관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Conformity Policy Bureau shall have the Testing and Certification Policy Division, the Conformity Assessment Division, the Certification Industry Promotion Division, and the Metrology and Measurement System Division; the head of the Testing and Certification Policy Division shall be appointed as a Deputy Director, Secretary of Science and Technology, Secretary, Industrial Research Officer, Environmental Research Officer, Facilities Research Officer, or Health Research Officer, and the head of the Conformity Assessment Division, the head of the Certification Industry Promotion Division, and the head of the Metrology and Measurement System Division shall be appointed as a Secretary of Science and Technology, Secretary, Industrial Research Officer, Environmental Research Officer, Facilities Research Officer, or Health Research Officer.

rows.source_ko: ③ 시험인증정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Testing and Certification Policy Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 시험(메디컬 시험을 포함한다. 이하 같다)ㆍ검사ㆍ교정ㆍ표준물질ㆍ제품인증ㆍ경영시스템인증 등(이하 “적합성평가”라 한다) 정책의 수립 및 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and overall management and coordination of policies regarding testing (including medical testing; hereinafter the same), inspection, calibration, standard materials, product certification, management system certification, etc. (hereinafter referred to as “Conformity Assessment”)

rows.source_ko: 2. 적합성평가 관련 산업(이하 “시험인증산업”이라 한다)의 육성ㆍ지원을 위한 정책 수립ㆍ추진
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment and implementation of policies for fostering and supporting industries related to conformity assessment (hereinafter referred to as the “Testing and Certification Industry”)

rows.source_ko: 3. 적합성평가 관련 표준의 제정ㆍ개정 지원
rows.text_en: 3. Support for the establishment and revision of standards related to conformity assessment

rows.source_ko: 4. 적합성평가 관련 국가 간 또는 기관 간 상호협력
rows.text_en: 4. Inter-country or inter-agency cooperation regarding conformity assessment

rows.source_ko: 5. 적합성평가 분야의 조사ㆍ분석 및 연구
rows.text_en: 5. Investigation, analysis, and research in the field of conformity assessment

rows.source_ko: 6. 적합성평가 제도 관련 정부 부처간 협력
rows.text_en: 6. Inter-ministerial cooperation regarding the conformity assessment system

rows.source_ko: 7. 시험인증산업의 국내외 시장동향 조사
rows.text_en: 7. Survey of Domestic and International Market Trends in the Testing and Certification Industry

rows.source_ko: 8. 적합성평가 관련 법령ㆍ제도의 운영과 연구ㆍ개선
rows.text_en: 8. Operation, Research, and Improvement of Laws and Systems Related to Conformity Assessment

rows.source_ko: 9. 시험인증산업 육성ㆍ지원과 관련된 기관ㆍ단체와의 협력
rows.text_en: 9. Cooperation with institutions and organizations related to the fostering and support of the testing and certification industry

rows.source_ko: 10. 품질경영정책의 수립ㆍ추진 및 품질경영촉진의 지원
rows.text_en: 10. Establishment and implementation of quality management policies and support for the promotion of quality management

rows.source_ko: 11. 품질경영중앙추진본부, 품질경영지원기관의 지정 및 국가품질 경영대회 개최 등 기업의 품질경영 확산에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Matters concerning the dissemination of quality management in companies, such as the designation of the Central Promotion Headquarters for Quality Management and quality management support organizations, and the hosting of the National Quality Management Conference.

rows.source_ko: 12. 품질 관련 단체 등과의 업무협력
rows.text_en: 12. Business cooperation with quality-related organizations, etc.

rows.source_ko: 13. 국가인증제도의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 13. Overall management and coordination of the national certification system

rows.source_ko: 14. 시험인증산업의 실태조사ㆍ분석 및 연구
rows.text_en: 14. Survey, Analysis, and Research on the Status of the Testing and Certification Industry

rows.source_ko: 15. 시험인증 전문인력의 양성 지원
rows.text_en: 15. Support for the training of specialized personnel in testing and certification

rows.source_ko: 16. 경영체제 인증 등 자격인증제도 운영
rows.text_en: 16. Operation of qualification certification systems, such as management system certification

rows.source_ko: 17. 적합성평가 관련 부정행위 조사 및 부정 성적서 유통 차단에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 17. Matters concerning the investigation of misconduct related to conformity assessment and the prevention of distribution of fraudulent test reports

rows.source_ko: 18. 경영체제 인정기구의 지정ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 18. Designation and Management of Management System Accreditation Bodies

rows.source_ko: 19. 적합성평가 관련 기술개발 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 19. Matters concerning support for technology development related to conformity assessment

rows.source_ko: 20. 그 밖에 적합성정책국 내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 20. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other divisions within the Conformity Policy Bureau

rows.source_ko: ④ 적합성평가과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Conformity Assessment Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 적합성평가기관 인정제도 정책의 수립, 육성 및 지원
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment, fostering, and support of policies for the accreditation system of conformity assessment bodies

rows.source_ko: 2. 적합성평가기관의 인정평가 및 공인기관 관리
rows.text_en: 2. Accreditation of Conformity Assessment Bodies and Management of Accredited Bodies

rows.source_ko: 3. 적합성평가기관 인정 및 공인기관 운영 관련 전문인력 양성기관의 지정ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 3. Designation and Management of Training Institutions for Professional Personnel Related to the Accreditation of Conformity Assessment Bodies and the Operation of Accredited Bodies

rows.source_ko: 4. 숙련도시험과 관련된 기준의 보급, 운영기관의 인정ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 4. Dissemination of standards related to proficiency testing, and accreditation and management of operating organizations

rows.source_ko: 5. 적합성평가기관 인정 및 공인기관 운영 관련 인력 양성 교육훈련계획의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 5. Establishment and implementation of education and training plans for personnel development related to the accreditation of conformity assessment bodies and the operation of accredited bodies

rows.source_ko: 6. 적합성평가기관 인정 관련 기준 등의 운영
rows.text_en: 6. Operation of standards, etc. related to the accreditation of conformity assessment bodies

rows.source_ko: 7. 적합성평가기관 인정 관련 국제협력기구(ILAC, IAF, APAC 등)와의 상호인정협정 등 국제협력
rows.text_en: 7. International cooperation regarding the accreditation of conformity assessment bodies, such as mutual recognition agreements with international cooperation organizations (ILAC, IAF, APAC, etc.)

rows.source_ko: 8. 국제적합성평가위원회(ISO CASCO 등)와의 교류ㆍ협력 지원
rows.text_en: 8. Support for exchange and cooperation with international conformity assessment committees (ISO, CASCO, etc.)

rows.source_ko: 9. 적합성평가기관 인정 관련 정부 부처 간 협력
rows.text_en: 9. Inter-ministerial cooperation regarding the accreditation of conformity assessment bodies

rows.source_ko: 10. 그 밖에 적합성평가기관 인정과 관련하여 다른 국ㆍ과에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Other matters regarding the accreditation of conformity assessment bodies that do not fall under other bureaus or divisions

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 인증산업진흥과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Certification Industry Promotion Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 기업에 대한 인증정보 제공
rows.text_en: 1. Provision of certification information about companies

rows.source_ko: 2. 국가통합인증마크제도(KC) 운영
rows.text_en: 2. Operation of the Korea Certification (KC) System

rows.source_ko: 3. 신기술ㆍ신제품 인증제도의 운영 및 관리
rows.text_en: 3. Operation and Management of the New Technology and New Product Certification System

rows.source_ko: 4. 신기술ㆍ신제품 인증업무 총괄
rows.text_en: 4. Overall management of new technology and new product certification業務

rows.source_ko: 5. 신기술ㆍ신제품의 발굴ㆍ개발 및 상용화 지원
rows.text_en: 5. Support for the discovery, development, and commercialization of new technologies and products

rows.source_ko: 6. 신기술ㆍ신제품 인증업무 관련 통계 및 산업기술 현황조사
rows.text_en: 6. Statistics on New Technology and New Product Certification and Survey on the Status of Industrial Technology

rows.source_ko: 7. 우수재활용제품ㆍ재제조제품 인증제도 운영 및 관리
rows.text_en: 7. Operation and Management of the Excellent Recycled and Remanufactured Product Certification System

rows.source_ko: 8. 「산업기술혁신 촉진법」에 따른 인증기관 지정 등 소관 인증 관련 기관 및 단체 등의 지정ㆍ관리 및 업무 협력
rows.text_en: 8. Designation and management of relevant certification agencies and organizations, such as the designation of certification bodies under the jurisdiction of the Industrial Technology Innovation Promotion Act, and business cooperation

rows.source_ko: 9. 신기술ㆍ신제품 등의 평가기법 개발ㆍ보급
rows.text_en: 9. Development and dissemination of evaluation techniques for new technologies, new products, etc.

rows.source_ko: 10. 인증제품의 공공구매, 수출 등 구매활성화 시책의 수립ㆍ추진
rows.text_en: 10. Establishment and implementation of policies to promote purchasing, such as public procurement and export of certified products

rows.source_ko: 11. 신기술ㆍ신제품ㆍ우수재활용제품 등 정부인증 관련 기관과의 업무 협력
rows.text_en: 11. Business cooperation with government certification agencies regarding new technologies, new products, excellent recycled products, etc.

rows.source_ko: 12. 융합신제품 인증지원과 관련된 사항
rows.text_en: 12. Matters related to certification support for new convergence products

rows.source_ko: 13. 산업융합 신제품 적합성 인증과 관련 기술개발을 통한 신산업의 창출 지원
rows.text_en: 13. Support for the creation of new industries through industrial convergence new product conformity certification and related technology development

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 계량측정제도과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Head of the Measurement and Metrology Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 계량ㆍ측정 관련 산업 육성에 관한 시행계획의 수립
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment of an implementation plan for fostering industries related to metrology and measurement

rows.source_ko: 2. 계량에 관한 법령 및 제도 운영
rows.text_en: 2. Operation of Laws and Systems Regarding Measurement

rows.source_ko: 3. 계량ㆍ측정제도 선진화, 시험ㆍ검사 능력의 향상 및 기술보급
rows.text_en: 3. Advancement of the metrology and measurement system, improvement of testing and inspection capabilities, and dissemination of technology

rows.source_ko: 4. 법정단위 사용 보급 및 확산
rows.text_en: 4. Dissemination and Expansion of the Use of Legal Units

rows.source_ko: 5. 계량기의 형식승인ㆍ검정 등의 기술기준 및 기준기 검사기준 제정ㆍ개정ㆍ폐지
rows.text_en: 5. Enactment, amendment, and abolition of technical standards for type approval, verification, etc. of measuring instruments, and inspection standards for reference instruments

rows.source_ko: 6. 계량기의 형식승인기관ㆍ검정기관 및 자체검정사업자 지정ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 6. Designation and Management of Type Approval Agencies, Inspection Agencies, and In-house Inspection Operators for Meters

rows.source_ko: 7. 정량표시상품의 지정ㆍ조사 및 정량 검사기준의 제정ㆍ개정 등 관리
rows.text_en: 7. Management of designation and investigation of products with quantitative labeling, and establishment and revision of quantitative inspection standards

rows.source_ko: 8. 정량표시상품 적합성확인기관의 지정 및 정량표시상품 자기 적합성 선언제도의 운영
rows.text_en: 8. Designation of Conformity Verification Bodies for Quantitatively Labeled Products and Operation of the Self-Declaration of Conformity System for Quantitatively Labeled Products

rows.source_ko: 9. 계량ㆍ측정에 관한 중장기정책의 수립 및 집행
rows.text_en: 9. Establishment and implementation of mid-to-long-term policies regarding metrology and measurement

rows.source_ko: 10. 계량ㆍ측정 관련 교육기관의 지정 및 전문인력의 양성
rows.text_en: 10. Designation of educational institutions related to metrology and measurement and training of specialized personnel

rows.source_ko: 11. 계량ㆍ측정 관련 국제기구와의 교류ㆍ협력 및 상호인정 협정에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Matters concerning exchange, cooperation, and mutual recognition agreements with international organizations related to metrology and measurement

rows.source_ko: 12. 계량ㆍ측정 관련 위원회의 구성 및 운영
rows.text_en: 12. Composition and Operation of Committees Related to Metrology and Measurement

rows.source_ko: 13. 한국계량측정협회 등 계량ㆍ측정 관련 단체와의 업무협조
rows.text_en: 13. Business cooperation with metrology and measurement-related organizations, such as the Korea Metrology and Measurement Association

rows.source_ko: 14. 그 밖에 계량측정제도와 관련하여 다른 국ㆍ과의 주관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 14. Other matters related to the metrology system that do not fall under the jurisdiction of other bureaus or divisions

rows.source_ko: 제22조(기술규제대응국) ① 기술규제대응국장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원ㆍ공업연구관ㆍ환경연구관ㆍ시설연구관 또는 보건연구관으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 22 (Technology Regulation Response Bureau) ① The Director of the Technology Regulation Response Bureau shall be appointed from among general civil servants, industrial research officers, environmental research officers, facility research officers, or health research officers belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of such position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 기술규제대응국에 기술규제정책과ㆍ무역기술장벽협상과ㆍ기술규제조정과 및 기술규제협력과를 두되, 기술규제정책과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업연구관ㆍ환경연구관ㆍ시설연구관 또는 보건연구관으로, 무역기술장벽협상과장ㆍ기술규제조정과장 및 기술규제협력과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업연구관ㆍ환경연구관ㆍ시설연구관 또는 보건연구관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Technical Regulation Response Bureau shall have the Technical Regulation Policy Division, the Trade and Technical Barriers Negotiation Division, the Technical Regulation Coordination Division, and the Technical Regulation Cooperation Division; the head of the Technical Regulation Policy Division shall be appointed as a Deputy Director, Secretary of Science and Technology, Secretary, Industrial Research Officer, Environmental Research Officer, Facilities Research Officer, or Health Research Officer, and the heads of the Trade and Technical Barriers Negotiation Division, the Technical Regulation Coordination Division, and the Technical Regulation Cooperation Division shall be appointed as Secretary of Science and Technology, Secretary, Industrial Research Officer, Environmental Research Officer, Facilities Research Officer, or Health Research Officer.

rows.source_ko: ③ 기술규제정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Technology Regulation Policy Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 무역기술장벽 및 소관분야 기술규제에 관한 종합계획의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management and coordination of comprehensive plans regarding trade technical barriers and technical regulations in relevant fields

rows.source_ko: 2. 무역기술장벽 관련 기업의 애로사항 발굴 및 대응
rows.text_en: 2. Identifying and Responding to Corporate Difficulties Related to Trade Technical Barriers

rows.source_ko: 3. 무역기술장벽 관련 법령ㆍ제도의 동향분석, 연구, 개선 및 전파
rows.text_en: 3. Analysis of trends, research, improvement, and dissemination of laws and systems related to technical barriers to trade

rows.source_ko: 4. 무역기술장벽 관련 산업육성 및 지원
rows.text_en: 4. Fostering and Supporting Industries Related to Trade Technical Barriers

rows.source_ko: 5. 무역기술장벽 및 소관분야 기술규제 대응 관련 전문인력 양성ㆍ교육에 관한 정책 수립ㆍ추진
rows.text_en: 5. Establishment and implementation of policies regarding the training and education of specialized personnel related to responding to trade technical barriers and technical regulations in the relevant field

rows.source_ko: 6. 무역기술장벽 관련 국제기구 및 국가와의 교류ㆍ협력 지원
rows.text_en: 6. Support for exchange and cooperation with international organizations and countries regarding trade technical barriers

rows.source_ko: 7. 무역기술장벽 대응을 위한 네트워크 구축, 운영 및 관리
rows.text_en: 7. Establishment, operation, and management of networks to respond to trade technical barriers

rows.source_ko: 8. 세계무역기구의 무역기술장벽 협정 이행 총괄
rows.text_en: 8. Overview of the Implementation of the WTO Agreement on Technical Barriers to Trade

rows.source_ko: 9. 세계무역기구의 무역기술장벽 공식 질의처 운영
rows.text_en: 9. Operation of the World Trade Organization's Official Inquiry Center for Technical Barriers to Trade

rows.source_ko: 10. 무역기술장벽 관련 업체ㆍ유관기관 및 정부부처 간 협력
rows.text_en: 10. Cooperation among companies, relevant agencies, and government ministries regarding trade technical barriers

rows.source_ko: 11. 무역기술장벽 관련 전문가 의견수렴
rows.text_en: 11. Gathering expert opinions on technical barriers to trade

rows.source_ko: 12. 무역기술장벽 및 소관분야 기술규제 대응 관련 모범규제관행 발굴ㆍ전파 및 정착
rows.text_en: 12. Identification, dissemination, and establishment of best regulatory practices related to responding to trade technical barriers and technical regulations in the relevant sector

rows.source_ko: 13. 무역기술장벽 및 소관분야 기술규제 관련 국제기구, 지역기구 및 외국정부와의 교류ㆍ협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 13. Matters concerning exchange and cooperation with international organizations, regional organizations, and foreign governments regarding trade technical barriers and technical regulations in the relevant field

rows.source_ko: 14. 그 밖에 무역기술장벽 및 소관분야 기술규제 정책ㆍ대응과 관련하여 다른 국ㆍ과의 주관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 14. Other matters regarding trade technical barriers and policies and responses to technical regulations in their respective fields that do not fall under the jurisdiction of other bureaus or divisions

rows.source_ko: ④ 무역기술장벽협상과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Director of the Trade and Technical Barriers Negotiation Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 통상협정의 무역기술장벽 분야 실무 교섭에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 1. Work concerning working-level negotiations on trade technical barriers in trade agreements

rows.source_ko: 2. 통상협정의 무역기술장벽 분야 협상안의 수립ㆍ조정에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the formulation and coordination of negotiation proposals in the field of trade technical barriers to trade agreements

rows.source_ko: 3. 통상협정의 무역기술장벽 관련 위원회 및 협의체 운영
rows.text_en: 3. Operation of Committees and Consultative Bodies Related to Trade Technical Barriers under Trade Agreements

rows.source_ko: 4. 통상협정의 무역기술장벽 추진과 관련된 연구과제의 개발ㆍ시행 및 연구결과의 관리
rows.text_en: 4. Development and implementation of research projects related to the promotion of trade technical barriers under trade agreements and management of research results

rows.source_ko: 5. 통상협정의 무역기술장벽 분야 이행, 활용 및 후속 업무
rows.text_en: 5. Implementation, Utilization, and Follow-up Work in the Sector of Trade Technical Barriers to Trade under Trade Agreements

rows.source_ko: 6. 세계무역기구의 무역기술장벽 위원회의 특정무역현안 대응에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the response to specific trade issues by the World Trade Organization's Committee on Technical Barriers to Trade

rows.source_ko: 7. 통상협정의 무역기술장벽 관련 업체ㆍ유관기관 및 정부부처 간 협력
rows.text_en: 7. Cooperation among companies, relevant agencies, and government ministries regarding trade technical barriers in trade agreements

rows.source_ko: 8. 무역기술장벽 관련 소관분야 상호인정협정 체결 및 이행에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning the conclusion and implementation of mutual recognition agreements in relevant fields related to trade technical barriers

rows.source_ko: 9. 무역기술장벽 관련 규제협력체 등 양자간 규제협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning bilateral regulatory cooperation, such as regulatory cooperation bodies regarding trade technical barriers
10. Deleted <June 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 11. 아시아태평양무역협정의 비관세조치 관련 대응
rows.text_en: 11. Response to Non-Tariff Measures under the Asia-Pacific Trade Agreement

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 기술규제조정과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Director of Technology Regulation Coordination is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 기술기준 및 시험ㆍ검사ㆍ인증에 관한 기술규제영향평가 실시
rows.text_en: 1. Conducting a Technical Regulatory Impact Assessment on Technical Standards and Testing, Inspection, and Certification

rows.source_ko: 2. 소관분야 기술규제 관련 실태조사 및 법ㆍ제도의 개선
rows.text_en: 2. Fact-finding survey on technical regulations in the relevant field and improvement of laws and systems

rows.source_ko: 3. 기술규제영향평가 관련 정부부처ㆍ유관기관과 협력
rows.text_en: 3. Cooperation with government ministries and related agencies regarding technical regulatory impact assessment

rows.source_ko: 4. 기술규제영향평가 관련 현장점검 업무
rows.text_en: 4. On-site inspection work related to technical regulatory impact assessment

rows.source_ko: 5. 기술규제영향평가 관련 분야별 자문위원회 운영
rows.text_en: 5. Operation of Sectoral Advisory Committees Related to Technical Regulatory Impact Assessment

rows.source_ko: 6. 적합성평가 존속 필요성의 검토와 검토 결과에 따른 이행 점검 관련 정부부처ㆍ유관기관과의 협력 및 대응
rows.text_en: 6. Review of the necessity of maintaining the conformity assessment and cooperation and response with government ministries and relevant agencies regarding implementation checks based on the review results

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 기술규제협력과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2026. 6. 2.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Head of the Technology Regulation Cooperation Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended June 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 소관 분야 기술규제 관련 업체ㆍ유관기관 및 중앙행정기관 간 협력
rows.text_en: 1. Cooperation among companies, relevant agencies, and central administrative agencies regarding technical regulations in the relevant field

rows.source_ko: 2. 국내외 표준 및 인증 관련 정보의 수집ㆍ제공ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 2. Collection, provision, and management of information related to domestic and international standards and certifications

rows.source_ko: 3. 국내외 표준 및 인증 관련 정보의 활용 및 대외 협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the utilization of information related to domestic and international standards and certifications and external cooperation

rows.source_ko: 4. 소관 분야 국내외 기술규제 관련 실태조사ㆍ분석 및 연구
rows.text_en: 4. Fact-finding surveys, analysis, and research on domestic and international technical regulations in the relevant field

rows.source_ko: 5. 소관 분야 국내 기술규제 관련 기업의 애로사항 발굴 및 대응
rows.text_en: 5. Identification and response to difficulties faced by companies regarding domestic technical regulations in the relevant field

rows.source_ko: 6. 소관 분야 국내 기술규제 대응 관련 모범규제관행 발굴ㆍ전파 및 정착
rows.text_en: 6. Identification, dissemination, and establishment of best regulatory practices related to responding to domestic technical regulations in the relevant field

rows.source_ko: 7. 국내 기술규제의 국제표준 부합화 조사ㆍ분석 및 평가에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the investigation, analysis, and evaluation of the harmonization of domestic technical regulations with international standards

rows.source_ko: 8. 수출기업 국외 인증 취득 지원을 위한 유관기관 간 협력
rows.text_en: 8. Cooperation among relevant organizations to support export companies in obtaining overseas certifications

rows.source_ko: 9. 국외 기술규제 및 인증 관련 기업지원 글로벌 현지 대응체계 구축
rows.text_en: 9. Establishment of a global local response system for corporate support regarding overseas technical regulations and certifications

rows.source_ko: 10. 국외 선진규제 분야 수출기업의 실무 대응역량 강화 지원
rows.text_en: 10. Support for Strengthening Practical Response Capabilities of Export Companies in Areas of Advanced Overseas Regulations

rows.source_ko: 제4장 경제자유구역기획단
rows.text_en: Chapter 4 Free Economic Zone Planning Group

rows.source_ko: 제23조(경제자유구역기획단) 경제자유구역기획단장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 23 (Economic Free Zone Planning Group) The Head of the Economic Free Zone Planning Group shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: 제5장 광업등록사무소
rows.text_en: Chapter 5 Mining Registration Office

rows.source_ko: 제24조(광업등록사무소장) 광업등록사무소장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: Article 24 (Head of Mining Registration Office) The head of the Mining Registration Office shall be appointed from among the Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Industrial Officer, or Administrative Officer.

rows.source_ko: 제25조(하부조직) ① 광업등록사무소에 등록팀 및 심사팀을 두되, 등록팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관 또는 행정사무관으로, 심사팀장은 공업사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: Article 25 (Subordinate Organization) ① The Mining Registration Office shall have a Registration Team and an Examination Team, and the head of the Registration Team shall be appointed as a Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Industrial Officer, or Administrative Officer, and the head of the Examination Team shall be appointed as an Industrial Officer or Administrative Officer.

rows.source_ko: ② 등록팀장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Registration Team Leader is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 주요업무 계획의 수립
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment of major business plans

rows.source_ko: 2. 인사ㆍ서무ㆍ보안ㆍ관인 및 관인대장의 관리
rows.text_en: 2. Management of Personnel, General Affairs, Security, Official Seals, and the Official Seal Register

rows.source_ko: 3. 문서의 수발ㆍ편찬ㆍ보존 및 관리
rows.text_en: 3. Receipt, compilation, preservation, and management of documents

rows.source_ko: 4. 물품의 구매ㆍ조달
rows.text_en: 4. Purchase and Procurement of Goods

rows.source_ko: 5. 재산 및 물품의 관리
rows.text_en: 5. Management of property and goods

rows.source_ko: 6. 자금의 운용ㆍ회계 및 결산
rows.text_en: 6. Fund Management, Accounting, and Settlement

rows.source_ko: 7. 광업권의 등록ㆍ취소
rows.text_en: 7. Registration and Cancellation of Mining Rights

rows.source_ko: 8. 광업원부의 관리 및 등본의 발급
rows.text_en: 8. Management of the Mining Register and Issuance of Copies

rows.source_ko: 9. 그 밖에 소 내 다른 팀의 주관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other teams within the office

rows.source_ko: ③ 심사팀장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The head of the review team shall be responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 광업권 설정출원에 대한 허가
rows.text_en: 1. Permission for application for establishment of mining rights

rows.source_ko: 2. 출원내용의 변경에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning changes to the application

rows.source_ko: 3. 광업출원카드의 관리
rows.text_en: 3. Management of Mining Application Cards

rows.source_ko: 4. 광업권 설정출원처분에 관한 소송사무 및 행정심판업무
rows.text_en: 4. Litigation and administrative appeals matters concerning the disposition of applications for the establishment of mining rights

rows.source_ko: 5. 광업권 설정출원에 따른 광상설명서의 검토
rows.text_en: 5. Review of the Mineral Deposit Description Pursuant to the Application for Establishment of Mining Rights

rows.source_ko: 6. 동일광상 부존광물의 확인
rows.text_en: 6. Confirmation of minerals in the same deposit

rows.source_ko: 7. 광구경계의 측량
rows.text_en: 7. Survey of mining area boundaries

rows.source_ko: 8. 광구도의 작성
rows.text_en: 8. Preparation of the photometric map

rows.source_ko: 제6장 자유무역지역관리원
rows.text_en: Chapter 6 Free Trade Zone Management Office

rows.source_ko: 제26조(관할구역) 자유무역지역관리원의 관할구역은 별표 1과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 26 (Jurisdiction) The jurisdiction of the Free Trade Zone Management Agency is as shown in Attached Table 1 .

rows.source_ko: 제27조(자유무역지역관리원장) 마산자유무역지역관리원장ㆍ군산자유무역지역관리원장ㆍ대불자유무역지역관리원장ㆍ김제자유무역지역관리원장 및 울산자유무역지역관리원장은 과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로, 동해자유무역지역관리원장 및 율촌자유무역지역관리원장은 공업사무관ㆍ시설사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: Article 27 (Directors of Free Trade Zones) The Directors of the Masan Free Trade Zone, Gunsan Free Trade Zone, Daebul Free Trade Zone, Gimje Free Trade Zone, and Ulsan Free Trade Zone shall be appointed as Science and Technology Secretary or Secretary, and the Directors of the Donghae Free Trade Zone and Yulchon Free Trade Zone shall be appointed as Industrial Officer, Facilities Officer, or Administrative Officer.

rows.source_ko: 제28조(마산자유무역지역관리원의 하부조직) ① 마산자유무역지역관리원에 관리과ㆍ수출산업과 및 투자홍보과를 두고, 관리과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ시설사무관 또는 행정사무관으로, 수출산업과장 및 투자홍보과장은 공업사무관ㆍ시설사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: Article 28 (Subordinate Organization of Masan Free Trade Zone Management Agency) ① The Masan Free Trade Zone Management Agency shall have a Management Division, an Export Industry Division, and an Investment Promotion Division. The head of the Management Division shall be appointed as a Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Industrial Officer, Facilities Officer, or Administrative Officer, and the head of the Export Industry Division and the head of the Investment Promotion Division shall be appointed as an Industrial Officer, Facilities Officer, or Administrative Officer.

rows.source_ko: ② 관리과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Head of the Management Department is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 보안ㆍ관인 및 관인대장의 관리
rows.text_en: 1. Management of Security, Official Seals, and Official Seal Registers

rows.source_ko: 2. 공무원의 임용(기능직공무원을 말한다)ㆍ전보(6급 이하 공무원을 말한다)ㆍ복무ㆍ교육훈련ㆍ연금, 그 밖의 인사관리
rows.text_en: 2. Appointment (referring to technical public officials), transfer (referring to public officials of Grade 6 or lower), service, education and training, pension, and other personnel management of public officials

rows.source_ko: 3. 문서의 수발ㆍ편찬ㆍ보존 및 관리
rows.text_en: 3. Receipt, compilation, preservation, and management of documents

rows.source_ko: 4. 자금의 운용ㆍ회계 및 결산
rows.text_en: 4. Fund Management, Accounting, and Settlement

rows.source_ko: 5. 물품의 구매ㆍ조달
rows.text_en: 5. Purchase and Procurement of Goods

rows.source_ko: 6. 재산 및 물품의 관리
rows.text_en: 6. Management of property and goods

rows.source_ko: 7. 관할 자유무역지역 안의 세입의 수납, 토지ㆍ공장 등의 임대 및 매매에 관한 계약
rows.text_en: 7. Contracts regarding the collection of revenue, and the lease and sale of land, factories, etc. within the competent free trade zone

rows.source_ko: 8. 지원기업체의 입주허가 및 사후관리
rows.text_en: 8. Occupancy Permission and Post-Management of Supported Companies

rows.source_ko: 9. 관할 자유무역지역 안의 지원 행정기관과의 업무협조
rows.text_en: 9. Business cooperation with supporting administrative agencies within the competent free trade zone

rows.source_ko: 10. 지원시설 및 후생시설의 관리
rows.text_en: 10. Management of support and welfare facilities

rows.source_ko: 11. 토지ㆍ공장 등의 양도 및 담보제공의 허가에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Matters concerning permission for the transfer of land, factories, etc., and the provision of collateral

rows.source_ko: 12. 안전관리업무에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 12. Matters concerning safety management duties

rows.source_ko: 13. 관리원의 정보화 및 정보통신 관련 사항
rows.text_en: 13. Matters related to the Informatization and Information and Communications of the Management Office

rows.source_ko: 14. 국가비상사태에 대비한 제반계획의 수립ㆍ종합 및 조정
rows.text_en: 14. Establishment, synthesis, and coordination of all plans in preparation for a national emergency

rows.source_ko: 15. 정부 비상훈련
rows.text_en: 15. Government Emergency Drill

rows.source_ko: 16. 직장예비군 및 민방위대의 관리
rows.text_en: 16. Management of Workplace Reserve Forces and Civil Defense Corps

rows.source_ko: 17. 관할 자유무역지역 안의 방호계획과 경비계획의 수립ㆍ실시
rows.text_en: 17. Establishment and implementation of protection and security plans within the free trade zone under jurisdiction

rows.source_ko: 18. 그 밖에 자유무역지역관리원 내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 18. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other divisions within the Free Trade Zone Management Agency

rows.source_ko: ③ 수출산업과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Export Industry Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 수출입의 허가 및 수출진흥에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning import and export permits and export promotion

rows.source_ko: 2. 외국인투자의 신고 및 등록에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the reporting and registration of foreign investment

rows.source_ko: 3. 외국인투자에 대한 조세감면 신청에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning applications for tax exemptions and reductions for foreign investment

rows.source_ko: 4. 물품의 원산지증명 발급에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the issuance of certificates of origin for goods

rows.source_ko: 5. 건축물, 그 밖의 시설설치의 허가에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the permit for the installation of buildings and other facilities

rows.source_ko: 6. 공사의 감독
rows.text_en: 6. Supervision of construction

rows.source_ko: 7. 환경오염방지에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the prevention of environmental pollution

rows.source_ko: 8. 근로조건의 개선과 관련된 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters related to the improvement of working conditions

rows.source_ko: 9. 기업체의 입주 계약의 체결ㆍ해지 및 사후관리
rows.text_en: 9. Conclusion, termination, and post-management of corporate occupancy contracts

rows.source_ko: ④ 투자홍보과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of Investment Promotion Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 자유무역지역 홍보 및 언론 대응
rows.text_en: 1. Promotion of the Free Trade Zone and Media Response

rows.source_ko: 2. 국내ㆍ외 투자유치 업무
rows.text_en: 2. Domestic and foreign investment attraction

rows.source_ko: 3. 자유무역지역의 안내
rows.text_en: 3. Guide to Free Trade Zones

rows.source_ko: 4. 홍보실 및 전시실 운영
rows.text_en: 4. Operation of Public Relations and Exhibition Halls

rows.source_ko: 5. 그 밖에 투자ㆍ홍보에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Other matters concerning investment and promotion

rows.source_ko: 제29조(군산자유무역지역관리원의 하부조직) ① 군산자유무역지역관리원에 관리과ㆍ수출산업과 및 투자유치과를 두되, 관리과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ시설사무관 또는 행정사무관으로, 수출산업과장 및 투자유치과장은 공업사무관ㆍ시설사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: Article 29 (Subordinate Organization of Gunsan Free Trade Zone Management Agency) ① The Gunsan Free Trade Zone Management Agency shall have a Management Division, an Export Industry Division, and an Investment Attraction Division; the head of the Management Division shall be appointed as a Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Industrial Officer, Facilities Officer, or Administrative Officer, and the heads of the Export Industry Division and the Investment Attraction Division shall be appointed as Industrial Officers, Facilities Officers, or Administrative Officers.

rows.source_ko: ② 관리과장은 제28조제2항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Head of the Management Division shall be responsible for the matters listed in each subparagraph of Article 28, Paragraph 2 .

rows.source_ko: ③ 수출산업과장은 제28조제3항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Export Industry Division shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 28, Paragraph 3 .

rows.source_ko: ④ 투자유치과장은 제28조제4항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Investment Attraction Division shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 28, Paragraph 4 .

rows.source_ko: 제30조(대불자유무역지역관리원의 하부조직) ① 대불자유무역지역관리원에 관리과 및 수출산업과를 두되, 관리과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ시설사무관 또는 행정사무관으로, 수출산업과장은 공업사무관ㆍ시설사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: Article 30 (Subordinate Organization of the Daebul Free Trade Zone Management Agency) ① The Daebul Free Trade Zone Management Agency shall have a Management Division and an Export Industry Division, and the head of the Management Division shall be appointed from among a Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Industrial Officer, Facilities Officer, or Administrative Officer, and the head of the Export Industry Division shall be appointed from among an Industrial Officer, Facilities Officer, or Administrative Officer.

rows.source_ko: ② 관리과장은 제28조제2항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Head of the Management Division shall be responsible for the matters listed in each subparagraph of Article 28, Paragraph 2 .

rows.source_ko: ③ 수출산업과장은 제28조제3항 각 호 및 같은 조 제4항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Export Industry Division shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 28, Paragraph 3 and each subparagraph of Article 28 , Paragraph 4 .

rows.source_ko: 제31조(김제자유무역지역관리원의 하부조직) ① 김제자유무역지역관리원에 관리과 및 수출산업과를 두고, 관리과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ시설사무관 또는 행정사무관으로, 수출산업과장은 공업사무관ㆍ시설사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: Article 31 (Subordinate Organization of Gimje Free Trade Zone Management Office) ① The Gimje Free Trade Zone Management Office shall have a Management Division and an Export Industry Division, and the head of the Management Division shall be appointed from among a Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Industrial Officer, Facilities Officer, or Administrative Officer, and the head of the Export Industry Division shall be appointed from among an Industrial Officer, Facilities Officer, or Administrative Officer.

rows.source_ko: ② 관리과장은 제28조제2항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Head of the Management Division shall be responsible for the matters listed in each subparagraph of Article 28, Paragraph 2 .

rows.source_ko: ③ 수출산업과장은 제28조제3항 각 호 및 같은 조 제4항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Export Industry Division shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 28, Paragraph 3 and each subparagraph of Article 28 , Paragraph 4 .

rows.source_ko: 제32조(울산자유무역지역관리원의 하부조직) ① 울산자유무역지역관리원에 관리과 및 수출산업과를 두고, 관리과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ시설사무관 또는 행정사무관으로, 수출산업과장은 공업사무관ㆍ시설사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: Article 32 (Subordinate Organization of Ulsan Free Trade Zone Management Agency) ① The Ulsan Free Trade Zone Management Agency shall have a Management Division and an Export Industry Division. The head of the Management Division shall be appointed from among Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Industrial Officer, Facilities Officer, or Administrative Officer, and the head of the Export Industry Division shall be appointed from among Industrial Officer, Facilities Officer, or Administrative Officer.

rows.source_ko: ② 관리과장은 제28조제2항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Head of the Management Division shall be responsible for the matters listed in each subparagraph of Article 28, Paragraph 2 .

rows.source_ko: ③ 수출산업과장은 제28조제3항 각 호 및 같은 조 제4항 각 호의 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Export Industry Division shall be responsible for the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 28, Paragraph 3 and each subparagraph of Article 28 , Paragraph 4 .

rows.source_ko: 제7장 광산안전사무소
rows.text_en: Chapter 7 Mining Safety Office

rows.source_ko: 제33조(관할구역) 광산안전사무소의 관할구역은 별표 2와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 33 (Jurisdiction) The jurisdiction of the Mine Safety Office is as shown in Appendix 2 .

rows.source_ko: 제34조(광산안전사무소장) 동부광산안전사무소장ㆍ중부광산안전사무소장 및 남부광산안전사무소장은 과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로, 서부광산안전사무소장은 공업사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: Article 34 (Heads of Mine Safety Offices) The heads of the Eastern Mine Safety Office, the Central Mine Safety Office, and the Southern Mine Safety Office shall be appointed as science and technology secretaries or secretaries, and the head of the Western Mine Safety Office shall be appointed as industrial officers or administrative officers.

rows.source_ko: 제8장 공무원의 정원
rows.text_en: Chapter 8. Staffing Levels of Public Officials

rows.source_ko: 제35조(산업통상부에 두는 공무원의 정원) ① 산업통상부에 두는 공무원의 직급별 정원(「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제25조제1항에 따른 한시정원은 제외한다. 이하 이 조에서 같다)은 별표 3과 같다. 다만, 「산업통상부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제43조제1항 단서에 따라 별표 3에 따른 총정원의 10퍼센트를 넘지 않는 범위에서 따로 정하는 공무원의 직급별 정원은 별표 4와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 35 (Personnel Quotas for Public Officials in the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy) ① The personnel quotas for public officials in the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy by rank (excluding temporary quotas pursuant to Article 25, Paragraph 1 of the “General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies”; hereinafter the same shall apply in this Article) shall be as set forth in Table 3. However, pursuant to the proviso to Article 43, Paragraph 1 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and Its Affiliated Agencies,” the personnel quotas for public officials by rank, determined separately within a range not exceeding 10 percent of the total personnel quota set forth in Table 3, shall be as set forth in Table 4.

rows.source_ko: ② 산업통상부에 두는 공무원의 정원 중 홍보업무를 담당하는 3명(4급 1명, 4급 또는 5급 2명), 통계업무를 담당하는 1명(5급 1명), 통상업무를 담당하는 3명(5급 3명), 법무행정업무를 담당하는 3명(5급 3명), 공공데이터 관련 업무를 담당하는 2명(5급 1명, 6급 1명), 노무행정업무를 담당하는 1명(6급 1명), 사서업무를 담당하는 6명(8급 6명) 및 그 밖의 정원 중 5명(3급ㆍ4급ㆍ연구관 또는 수석전문관 1명, 5급 4명)은 임기제공무원으로 임용할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② Among the authorized number of public officials in the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy, three people in charge of public relations (one person of Grade 4, and two people of Grade 4 or 5), one person in charge of statistics (one person of Grade 5), three people in charge of trade affairs (three people of Grade 5), three people in charge of legal administration affairs (three people of Grade 5), two people in charge of public data-related affairs (one person of Grade 5, and one person of Grade 6), one person in charge of labor administration affairs (one person of Grade 6), six people in charge of library affairs (six people of Grade 8), and five people among the other authorized number of officials (one person of Grade 3, Grade 4, a research officer, or a senior specialist, and four people of Grade 5) may be appointed as fixed-term public officials.

rows.source_ko: ③ 산업통상부에 두는 공무원의 정원 중 디지털 홍보 업무를 담당하는 2명(5급 1명, 6급 1명)은 임기제공무원으로 임용한다. <신설 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ③ Among the authorized number of public officials in the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy, two persons responsible for digital public relations (one at Grade 5 and one at Grade 6) shall be appointed as fixed-term public officials. <Newly added Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제36조(소속기관에 두는 공무원의 정원) ① 산업통상부의 소속기관에 두는 공무원의 직급별 정원은 별표 5와 같다. 다만, 「산업통상부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제44조제1항 단서에 따라 별표 5에 따른 총 정원의 10퍼센트를 넘지 않는 범위에서 따로 정하는 공무원의 직급별 정원은 별표 6과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 36 (Personnel Quotas for Public Officials in Affiliated Agencies) ① The personnel quotas for public officials by rank in the agencies of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy shall be as set forth in Table 5. However, pursuant to the proviso of Article 44, Paragraph 1 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and Its Affiliated Agencies,” the personnel quotas by rank, determined separately within a range not exceeding 10 percent of the total personnel quotas set forth in Table 5, shall be as set forth in Table 6.

rows.source_ko: ② 국가기술표준원에 두는 공무원의 정원 중 7명(4급 또는 연구관 2명, 5급 3명, 6급 2명), 광업등록사무소에 두는 공무원의 정원 중 18명(6급 10명, 7급 7명, 8급 1명), 광산안전사무소에 두는 공무원의 정원 중 19명(6급 10명, 7급 5명, 8급 4명)은 임기제공무원으로 임용할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② Seven of the authorized number of public officials at the National Institute of Standards and Technology (2 Grade 4 or Research Officers, 3 Grade 5, and 2 Grade 6), 18 of the authorized number of public officials at the Mining Registration Office (10 Grade 6, 7 Grade 7, and 1 Grade 8), and 19 of the authorized number of public officials at the Mine Safety Office (10 Grade 6, 5 Grade 7, and 4 Grade 8) may be appointed as fixed-term public officials.

rows.source_ko: 제37조(시간선택제채용공무원 정원의 운영) 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제24조제3항 및 「공무원임용령」 제3조의3제1항에 따라 산업통상부와 그 소속기관에 두는 시간선택제채용공무원 정원은 산업통상부와 그 소속기관에 두는 공무원의 정원 중 일부를 활용하여 운영할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 37 (Operation of Quotas for Part-time Public Officials) Pursuant to Article 24, Paragraph 3 of the “General Rules on the Organization and Quotas of Administrative Agencies” and Article 3-3, Paragraph 1 of the “Public Officials Appointment Decree,” the quota for part-time public officials in the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and its affiliated agencies may be operated by utilizing a portion of the quota for public officials in the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and its affiliated agencies.

rows.source_ko: 제38조(전문직공무원 정원의 배정 및 운영에 대한 특례) 「산업통상부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제46조제2항 후단에 따라 전문직공무원을 두는 하부조직은 다음 각 호와 같다. <개정 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 38 (Special Provisions on the Allocation and Operation of Quotas for Professional Public Officials) Subordinate organizations to which professional public officials are employed pursuant to the latter part of Article 46, Paragraph 2 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and Its Affiliated Agencies” are as follows: <Amended Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 통상정책국: 통상정책총괄과, 미주통상과, 구주통상과, 신통상전략과, 디지털경제통상과, 기후경제통상과, 한미통상협력과
rows.text_en: 1. Trade Policy Bureau: Trade Policy Coordination Division, Americas Trade Division, Europe Trade Division, New Trade Strategy Division, Digital Economy & Trade Division, Climate Economy & Trade Division, Korea-US Trade Cooperation Division

rows.source_ko: 2. 통상협력국: 통상협력총괄과, 동북아통상과, 아주통상과, 중동아프리카통상과
rows.text_en: 2. Trade Cooperation Bureau: General Trade Cooperation Division, Northeast Asia Trade Division, Asia Trade Division, Middle East and Africa Trade Division

rows.source_ko: 3. 통상교섭실: 통상협정정책기획과, 통상협정이행과, 통상협정활용과, 통상협정협상총괄과, 통상협정상품과, 통상협정서비스투자과, 통상협정무역규범과, 통상법무기획과, 세계무역기구과, 다자통상협력과, 통상분쟁대응과
rows.text_en: 3. Trade Negotiation Office: Trade Agreement Policy Planning Division, Trade Agreement Implementation Division, Trade Agreement Utilization Division, Trade Agreement Negotiation Management Division, Trade Agreement Goods Division, Trade Agreement Services & Investment Division, Trade Agreement Trade Norms Division, Trade Legal Affairs Planning Division, World Trade Organization Division, Multilateral Trade Cooperation Division, Trade Dispute Response Division

rows.source_ko: 제40조(한미통상협력과) ① 한미통상협력과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업연구관 또는 수석전문관으로 보한다. <개정 2026. 3. 24.>
rows.text_en: Article 40 (Korea-U.S. Trade Cooperation Division) ① The Head of the Korea-U.S. Trade Cooperation Division shall be appointed from among the Secretary for Science and Technology, Secretary, Research Officer for Industry, or Senior Specialist. <Amended Mar. 24, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ② 한미통상협력과에 두는 공무원의 직급별 정원은 별표 7의2와 같다.
rows.text_en: ② The authorized number of public officials by rank in the Korea-US Trade Cooperation Division is as set forth in Attached Table 7-2 .
